title: VIdeo Editor for Meta/Facebook Direct Response Ecommerce Ads, Short-form/VSLs
description:
Looking for an Ambitious Video Editor Who Wants to Become Top 1%



We’re looking for a passionate video editor who genuinely enjoys creating videos that make money for brands.



We run several 7-figure ecommerce brands in the US and primarily advertise through Meta/Facebook using fast-paced short-form video ads, AI-generated B-roll, AI characters, and UGC-style content.



Example ad: 



The editing itself is not overly complicated. What matters much more to us is that you learn quickly, enjoy editing, can work in a fast-paced environment, think creatively instead of only following instructions, constantly look for ways to make an ad better, and genuinely want to improve your skills.



We are willing to invest heavily in teaching and developing the right person, with the goal of helping you become a top-tier DTC video editor.



If your goal is to rapidly improve your skills, take on a lot of work, and build a long-term career, this could be a great opportunity.



If you're mainly looking for a relaxed side job with very little pressure or volume, this probably isn't the right fit.



You do NOT need AI experience, but it is ideal if you have some.



We will provide the tools, software, systems, and initial training you need.



Professional editing experience is also not the most important thing to us. If you have strong fundamentals, good taste, motivation, and the ability to learn quickly, we want to hear from you.



What you'll actually do:



We give you the script.



You generate content using our AI tools, find suitable B-roll, and put everything together into engaging 1–2 minute Meta ads.



You will also handle pacing, cuts, visuals, music, and creative touches that make the ad more engaging.



Captions are automatically generated and we can provide the software.



Scripts are provided by us.



Compensation:



We start with 1–2 paid test projects at approximately $10/hour, paid per completed video.



If things go well, we quickly increase the amount of work.



As your skill and reliability improve, we can increase your rate over time.



Our ideal outcome is to find someone we can work with for years, potentially full-time, who could eventually become a senior editor and even help train other editors.



Hiring process:



1. Send us examples of your previous work and a short introduction. Tell us why you started editing, your experience so far, what you enjoy about editing, and why this opportunity interests you.



2. We'll have a short call with the strongest applicants.



3. If you're a good fit, we'll immediately start with 1–2 paid test projects.



4. During the first two weeks, you'll ideally edit around 10–15 videos, usually around one minute long.



5. If the quality is strong, we'll continue increasing your workload, responsibility, and pay.



We're not looking for someone who simply wants to complete tasks.



We're looking for someone who wants to become exceptionally good at this.

title: Google Ads + Meta Ads Digital Strategist (Media Buyer)
description:
We're looking for our next Digital Strategist, a Google Ads and Meta Ads STAR who can own ad accounts strategically, not just execute tasks.



Matriarch Digital is a Sydney-based paid ads agency working with eCommerce brands and service-based businesses. We run a team built on real results, and we need someone who can match that bar.



About the role



This is a full-time position (8 hours a day) where you'll manage a portfolio of client accounts across Google Ads and Meta Ads. We're not after a media buyer who waits for instructions. - Prior agency experience is essential. You know what it means to manage multiple client accounts under time pressure and shifting priorities

- Strong, hands-on experience with both Google Ads and Meta Ads management, not just one platform

- Sharp attention to detail. You catch the small errors before they become client-facing i

- Comfortable owning a conversation about account performance, not just reporting numbers

- Fluent or native English speaker, both written and spoken



What we offer:

- A fun, flexible, high-performing team culture where you're trusted to own your accounts

- Senior-level ownership from day one, with a clear path to Lead Digital Strategist if you're ready for it

- An LGBTQ+ friendly workplace where diverse perspectives are part of how we win



If you're someone who takes pride in getting the details right and wants to work somewhere that actually values senior thinking over just execution, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Social Media & Performance Marketing Manager
description:
About Kids Chalet



At Kids Chalet (
), we believe that every child deserves a loving, safe and inspiring environment where they can grow, learn and thrive. Our bilingual daycare and preschool combines high-quality early childhood education with a warm, family-oriented environment.



Our first location opened in Emmen (Lucerne) in May 2026, and we are building Kids Chalet with the ambition to grow into a leading bilingual childcare provider in Switzerland.



As we grow, our digital presence plays an increasingly important role in connecting Kids Chalet with families who are looking for the right childcare solution for their children.



Your Role



We are looking for a Social Media & Performance Marketing Manager who can turn our social media presence into measurable business results.



You will be responsible for developing and executing paid and organic social media strategies across Instagram,
, TikTok and LinkedIn, with a particular focus on generating qualified leads, increasing tour enquiries and converting digital interest into new enrolments.



You will work closely with our Social Media Assistant, who is responsible for creating and preparing organic content. Your role is to take that content, identify what resonates with our target audience and turn it into effective campaigns that reach the right families at the right time.



This is a hands-on role for someone who understands both social media and performance marketing and enjoys working with data, testing ideas and improving results.



What You Bring

• Proven experience in social media management, digital marketing, performance marketing or a comparable role.

• Strong practical knowledge of Instagram,
, TikTok and LinkedIn.

• Hands-on experience creating and managing paid social media campaigns, particularly through Meta Ads Manager.

• A strong understanding of lead generation, conversion funnels, retargeting and audience targeting.

• Experience analysing campaign performance and making decisions based on data.

• An understanding of how to turn social media attention into measurable commercial results.

• Experience with analytics and reporting tools such as Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics and/or similar platforms.

• Strong understanding of social media trends, short-form video and digital advertising formats.

• Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines independently.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. German is highly advantageous.

• A creative, entrepreneurial and solution-oriented mindset.

• Strong attention to detail and an ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the wider Kids Chalet team.



Experience in childcare, education, family services, hospitality or another consumer-facing sector is an advantage, but not essential.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured primarily by business outcomes rather than follower numbers alone. Make sure to write "Kids Chalet - take off" in your
 header to be considered for the job.



Key objectives include:

• Increasing the number of qualified enquiries generated through digital channels.

• Increasing the number of families booking tours.

• Improving the conversion of digital leads into enrolments.

• Reducing the cost per qualified lead.

• Increasing the return on advertising spend.

• Identifying and scaling campaigns that consistently generate new families for Kids Chalet.

• Building a strong and recognisable Kids Chalet presence across relevant social media platforms.



What You Can Expect From Us

• A meaningful role in the growth of a young and ambitious Swiss childcare company.

• The opportunity to shape Kids Chalet's digital marketing strategy from an early stage.

• A collaborative and entrepreneurial working environment.

• Flexible working arrangements remote work.

• The opportunity to take ownership of campaigns and see the direct impact of your work.

• A warm and supportive team environment.

• Flexible working hours and company holidays over Christmas.

- Analytical Skills: Proficient in using analytics tools to extract and measure copy performance metrics, including open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, engagement data, lead quality, and search visibility.

- Data-driven Thinking Skills: Ability to interpret, evaluate, and synthesise data findings and insights to inform strategic decisions, identify patterns, and improve copy, messaging, and campaign performance.

- Product/Service Knowledge: Ability to rapidly build a deep understanding of gigCMO’s services and translate strategic marketing, fractional CMO, growth consultancy, and capability-building concepts into compelling, customer-centric narratives.

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Researcher — US Marketplace
description:
Join an established, long-term Amazon business. We have been operating for over 4 years and are building a stable remote team, not hiring for a short-term, high-turnover role. One of our current team members will reach 3 years with us this October.



We offer structured onboarding, ongoing support, performance reviews and genuine opportunities to increase your earnings as you grow in the role.



Salary: ₱30,000 per month

Bonuses: We have a monthly bonus scheme in place, available from day one. Full details can be discussed on a call.

Performance review: Salary increase review within the first 3 months, based on performance

Other benefits: 22 days paid leave, 13th-month pay and long-term progression opportunities

Hours: Full-time, 8 hours per day. You may choose your start time, provided your 8 hours are completed by 5:00 PM Philippine time each working day.

Location: Remote - Philippines-based applicants



We are an established US-focused Amazon online arbitrage business looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Amazon Product Researcher to join our remote team.



Your role will be to find profitable products from US online retailers and analyse them for resale on Amazon US.



This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone who already understands US online arbitrage and can confidently assess leads using the relevant software and Amazon data.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Research profitable online-arbitrage products from US retailers every day

• Analyse potential products using Keepa and SellerAmp SAS

• Check sales rank, price history, offer count, estimated sales, competition, fees, ROI and profit margins

• Create and maintain accurate product-lead spreadsheets, including source links, buy cost, selling price, ROI, profit, BSR, seller count and relevant notes

• Identify and avoid restricted brands, gated products, hazmat items, IP-risk products, bundles and other unsuitable leads

• Look for discounts, cashback opportunities, retailer promotions and valid discount codes where relevant

• Stay up to date with Amazon policies, OA sourcing practices and retailer changes

• Consistently identify high-quality, buyable leads. As a general guide, strong researchers often submit around 5–10 suitable leads per day, but quality and purchase value matter more than raw lead volume

• Communicate clearly with the team and respond positively to feedback



PRODUCTS WE PREFER



We source across a range of categories, but our strongest areas generally include:



• Tools and home improvement

• Coffee and kitchen-related products

• Clothing and footwear

• Electronics and accessories

• Household and practical consumer products



We are generally not focused on beauty, and we do not usually prioritise toys and games. Experience sourcing in our preferred categories is a strong advantage.



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



To be considered, you must have:



• At least 12 months of hands-on Amazon online-arbitrage product research experience for the US marketplace

• Fluent written and spoken English; this is essential for the role

• Strong working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp SAS

• Experience finding genuine OA leads from a broad range of retailer sites that meet our minimum criteria

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work carefully and independently

• Confidence using Google Sheets or Excel

• A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection and professional work-from-home setup

• Willingness to use time-tracking software during working hours



Experience with cashback sites, retailer discount strategies and coupon finding is also highly valued.



PAY, BONUS AND GROWTH



Your starting base salary will be ₱30,000 per month.



We will carry out a performance and salary review within your first 3 months. Strong performance can lead to an increase in base salary.



In addition, we have a well-established monthly bonus scheme. It is already built, tested and available from your first day; it is not a promise for later. Full details of how it works can be discussed on a call.



We are looking for a dependable long-term team member. We provide clear feedback, fair performance expectations and opportunities to develop within the business.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send a tailored application and CV. We receive a very high volume of applications, so generic copy-and-paste responses will not be considered.



We want to understand why your experience is suitable for this role, the categories you have sourced in, and how you approach evaluating an OA lead.



SHOW US YOUR WORK



This is the part of the application we care about most. Please provide a small sample of at least 5 leads, showing the variety of retailers and products you typically look at in a day. This can be:



OPTION A: Sample leads or a sample lead spreadsheet. Screenshots or a view-only Google Sheets link are welcome. Please remove or blur confidential information from previous employers.



OPTION B: If you cannot share previous work, find at least 5 current live leads and show your analysis for each: source link, buy cost, expected selling price, Amazon fees, ROI and a brief explanation of why you believe it is a worthwhile purchase.



Either option is acceptable. We would rather see a genuine sample of leads you have analysed than a long generic description of your process. Submitted demonstration leads are for assessment purposes and do not guarantee that we will purchase them.



Please also answer the following in your application:



1. How many years of Amazon online-arbitrage product research experience do you have, specifically for Amazon US?

2. Which product categories and US retailers do you have the most experience sourcing from? Please mention whether you have sourced in areas such as tools, home improvement, clothing, electronics, coffee, kitchen or household goods.

3. Which tools do you use for OA research and analysis? Keepa and SellerAmp SAS experience is required.

4. What daily lead volume and approval rate have you achieved in previous OA roles? Please briefly outline the checks you normally make before submitting a lead.

5. Are you currently working for another Amazon OA seller or sourcing agency? If so, please briefly explain whether there would be any conflict of interest.

6. Are you comfortable using time-tracking software, and when would you be available to start?



Include the word "Copper" in your
 subject line. Applications without this word in the subject line will be ignored.



Please do not submit a bulk or generic template application. We can quickly identify applications that have not been written specifically for this vacancy, and they will not be considered.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
We are looking for someone who combines technical AI skills with strong video editing and sound design.



The role has two parts: setting up an LTX video-generation system, either locally or on rented GPU servers, and using it alongside conventional editing to create engaging children’s YouTube videos.



We want someone who can turn photos, illustrations, narration and music into polished videos that feel alive, rather than basic slideshows.



You need to be comfortable with both the technical setup and the creative production. Experience using online AI generators alone is not sufficient.



1. Set up our LTX video-generation system



Review our existing hardware and requirements, then recommend whether we should run LTX locally or through rented GPU servers. Explain the likely costs, performance, limitations and ease of use before we agree on an approach.



Once agreed, you will install and configure LTX, the necessary dependencies and a suitable interface such as ComfyUI. We only need the chosen solution implemented, not both local and cloud systems.



Create a reusable image-to-video workflow that allows us to upload an image, enter a prompt, adjust the main settings and generate a clip.



Test the system with our supplied images, troubleshoot problems and demonstrate the actual generation times and output quality. We need realistic expectations, including the cost and time involved in unsuccessful generations and retries.



Cost control is important. For rented servers, explain all ongoing charges, configure appropriate idle or shutdown controls where supported, and clearly document how to stop the system and which charges may continue. No spending or recurring commitments should be activated without approval.



Provide the workflow files, setup documentation and a short recorded walkthrough so another team member can operate the system. Accounts and installations must remain under our control.



2. Create visually engaging videos



Use supplied scripts, narration, photos, illustrations, music and songs to create finished children’s story videos.



Combine thoughtful editing with selective AI-generated animation. You should know when animation adds value and when a well-edited still image is the better choice.



Use purposeful camera movements, pans, zooms, layered depth effects, reaction shots and well-timed cuts to support the storytelling. Maintain consistent character appearances and visual style, and reject generated footage with distracting distortions or unwanted changes.



We want a warm, cinematic and imaginative feel, with pacing that holds children’s attention without relying on constant noise, excessive effects or frantic cutting.



For song sequences, the visuals should follow the rhythm and emotional progression of the music.



3. Make the audio engaging and professional



Sound quality is just as important as the visuals.



Preserve the clarity and natural quality of the supplied narration and character voices. Balance dialogue, music, atmosphere and sound effects so speech remains easy to understand.



Use appropriate environmental sounds and well-timed effects to bring scenes to life, without overwhelming the narration. Avoid unnecessary voice processing, distortion, abrupt volume changes or repetitive sound effects.



We need someone who understands how sound supports storytelling, not simply someone who adds a music track underneath a video.



Skills and experience



You should have:



Hands-on experience installing and troubleshooting LTX, together with experience of ComfyUI or a comparable workflow interface.

The ability to assess local GPU hardware and rented GPU options, manage dependencies and resolve technical errors.

Strong editing skills in DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent software, including audio mixing and sound design.

A portfolio demonstrating visual storytelling, particularly videos created from still images or illustrations.

Clear English communication, organised project files and the ability to work independently while responding well to feedback.



Experience with children’s content, illustrated stories, animation or music videos would be valuable.



Deliverables



For the setup, we expect a working, tested system, reusable workflows, clear operating instructions and a complete handover.



For ongoing editing, we expect finished videos in the agreed format, editable project files and organised supporting assets.



Use only authorised or appropriately licensed assets. Supplied voice recordings must not be used for voice cloning, model training or unrelated projects.



How to apply



Please include:



Two or three relevant video examples. At least one should demonstrate how you made still images or illustrations engaging. Explain exactly which parts you created, including the audio work.

Evidence of your LTX setup experience. Describe a system you personally installed, the hardware or hosting used, and a technical problem you solved. Screenshots or a short demonstration are welcome, with private information hidden.

Your proposed approach. Briefly explain what you would need to assess local versus rented-server options.

Your rates and availability. Quote the initial setup separately from your ongoing editing rate, and state your weekly availability.

An indicative production timeframe. Estimate how long an 8–10-minute narrated story video would take when the main images, narration and music are supplied. Explain your assumptions.



Please use “LTX Setup and Video Editor” as your application subject.



Paid trial



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid 45–60-second editing test using supplied images, narration and music.



We will assess visual storytelling, pacing, sound design and preservation of voice quality. Technical experience will be assessed separately through a walkthrough of previous work, with the actual installation treated as an agreed paid milestone.



We are looking for someone who can both build a reliable production system and use it to make excellent videos.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Empire Barbershop is AMBA’s #1 Barbershop of the Year for 2025. We’re a single location in Oakleigh becoming something considerably larger — a rebrand lands this quarter, a second site opens early next year, and the plan after that is not modest.



Our core value is Service First. The whole client experience is the product, not just the cut. Our marketing has to be worthy of that, which frankly it currently isn’t. That’s the job.



What you’ll own



 • Reactivation.
 and SMS campaigns across our Fresha database via Klaviyo. This is your first and biggest win — cheapest revenue in the business, currently untouched.

 • Lifecycle marketing. Segmentation, automated flows, win-backs, and a send calendar that runs without being chased.

 • Organic and social. Turning a shop full of talented barbers into a content engine. You won’t be shooting everything yourself — you’ll build the system that makes it repeatable.

 • Influencer and UGC. Local creators, real partnerships, measurable outcomes. Not gifting haircuts and hoping.

 • The relaunch and Christmas campaigns. Both land in your first quarter. No easing in.



How you’ll be measured



We run a weighted scorecard, reviewed quarterly:



 • Qualified leads — 40%

 • Marketing-sourced revenue — 30%

 • Execution and delivery — 20%

 • Brand — 10%



Underneath that: new clients per week, cost per acquired client, new-client rebooking rate, and reactivation rate. You’ll have a real budget and real autonomy to spend it.



Who we’re looking for



You’ve run lifecycle marketing that actually moved revenue, and you can point to the numbers. You’re fluent in Klaviyo or similar. You write copy people finish reading. You have opinions about what we’re doing wrong and you’ll say so in the interview.



You’re not precious about channel purity — if a scrappy SMS blast outperforms a beautiful campaign, you ship the SMS blast.



If your instinct is to report on impressions and follower growth, this isn’t the role.



What’s in it



120k peso, performance bonus tied to the scorecard, and a genuine seat at the table as we scale. You’d also have access to School of Barbers, our sister education business, which gives you a second brand and audience to work with.



To apply



Send your CV and a case study on how you would build the brand

title: Instagram Content Creator + Copywriter (Personal Brand / Online Business) — Proven Growth Required
description:
ABOUT US



AGENCY678 is a UK based sales and operations consultancy. We help online agency and service business owners fix their offer and install a proper sales system so they stop leaking revenue they've already earned.



Our core offer is The Velocity System. It's for agency owners already doing consistent months who have stalled because their sales process is held together with good intentions, a messy CRM and a follow up that never happens. We fix the offer, install the system, and recover revenue already sitting in the business. We deliberately don't lead with paid ads.



I'm Zoe, the founder. Ex corporate & online closer, six plus years in sales before I built this. I'm growing my personal brand on 
 and we have aggressive targets for the rest of 2026. Instagram is the engine for that.



THE ROLE



You'll own the creation, copy and scheduling of my Instagram content, with a heavy focus on trial reels.



Day to day:



- Write copy: hooks, captions, story copy, carousel slides, DM scripts. This is a big part of the role, not an afterthought. You'll be given the strategy, the angles and the positioning, and you'll write from it

- Create and schedule trial reels (we run a high volume batch cadence, roughly 5 reels a day)

- Edit talking head video: trim, caption, text overlays, sync music, mute original audio where needed

- Hold the brand visual standards (approved fonts only, text placed in the empty space in frame rather than dead centre, music over muted original audio)

- Track what performs, flag the winners, and tell me what you think we should double down on

- Bring ideas. I don't want an order taker. I want someone who watches the account and says "this angle is working, let's push it"



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



Must haves:



- Strong copywriting. You can write hooks and captions that sound like a real person with a point of view, not like AI. This is the number one thing I'm hiring for alongside proven growth

- Proven experience growing Instagram accounts, with numbers you can show me

- Proven experience creating content that generates organic leads and enquiries, not just views

- Confident editing talking head video for reels

- You understand the online business, agency and coaching space. You know what an offer, a pipeline, a sales call and a close actually are, and you can write about them without sounding vague

- Proactive, organised, and you follow a brief exactly. If I ask for the first 5 for review before you schedule the rest, that's what I need

- Excellent written English



Nice to have but not essential:



Experience with trial reels specifically

Experience writing for a founder or personal brand in the B2B or sales space



What you do NOT need:



You don't need to be a Canva wizard. I'm very happy for content to be created natively in the Instagram app. That's how I work and it suits the style of the account



HOURS AND PAY



Part time, 10 to 20 hours per week

$10 to $20 USD per hour depending on experience and proven results

Long term role for the right person, with scope to increase hours

Some overlap with UK hours preferred, but I'm flexible



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without the below will not be read.



Please send me:



- Two or three Instagram accounts you have grown. Include the handle, how long you worked on it, follower count when you started and when you finished, and screenshots of the insights to back it up

- Proof of ROI. Show me enquiries, DMs, call bookings or sales that came from content you made. Screenshots or numbers are fine

- Three to five examples of reels you personally created and edited. Send links

- Two examples of copy you have written. Captions, hooks, or a carousel. It must be your own writing, not AI

Answer these three questions in your reply:

- What makes a hook stop someone scrolling? Give me one example of a hook you have written that performed and tell me why it worked

- What would you check first if a reel got high views but no enquiries?

- Tell me about a time you spotted something in the content data and changed the approach off the back of it



Start your application with the word VELOCITY so I know you've read the whole thing



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid test task (2 to 3 hours): I'll give you an angle plus some raw talking head footage. You'll write the hook and caption and create the finished reel to my brand standards.



I'm looking for someone who genuinely wants to build something with me, not just tick off tasks. If that's you, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Amazon Seller Central Account Manager - Listings, Deals & Catalog
description:
Dear applicant,



Thank you for your interest in our job assignment. We are looking for a dedicated Person who is willing to support our team in full time in the field of Amazon Account Management. After a phase of training and integration into our team and systems, you will be the person in charge for our product listings, prices and deals on the European Amazon marketplaces. You will make sure that every product is listed correctly, priced correctly and promoted at the right time. We are therefore looking for a person with an especially high sense for responsibility, high vigilance and detail orientation. Pre-knowledge is beneficial, but first and foremost you must be willing to learn about Amazon Account Management quickly.



What you will be doing:

• Maintaining and improving our product listings across all European marketplaces (titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, product data)

• Keeping our variation families (parent/child) clean and complete, so customers always see the full product range on one page

• Managing our prices and strike-through prices (UVP) per marketplace and watching the Buy Box

• Planning and submitting our Amazon deals (Best Deals, Lightning Deals), checking that every deal price is correct and follows the European price rules

• Watching running deals and reacting when Amazon suppresses or rejects one

• Analysing customer returns and reviews to find product problems and report them to the team

• Keeping our product compliance information correct and up to date

• Communicating with Amazon Seller Support when listings or deals need to be fixed



The skills you will need:

• Perfect English in writing, speaking and understanding.

• Good skills with computer, office programs, especially Excel

• You are comfortable with numbers, percentages and simple calculations, because prices and discounts are a daily part of the job

• Knowledge about E-Commerce, Amazon Seller Central and marketplace business is welcome, but not mandatory. It is most important that you are willing to learn. We can teach you all the important aspects of the job.



We are looking for a person with the following personality traits and values:

• Looking for long term employment

• Highly motivated

• Honest, reliable and transparent

• High sense for responsibility

• Vigilant and detail oriented

• Structured and able to work through repeating tasks without losing accuracy

• Learns from mistakes

• Loves to improve and learn

• Learns quickly



What we can offer you:

• Long term employment starting as soon as October 2026.

• Help you to grow your skill set and knowledge about Amazon, E-Commerce and international business

• Work with our own in-house software, which we build and improve together with the team

• Be a part of a small but highly motivated team

• Flexible working time and location

• Fair salary with performance based raises

• After established and proven work relationship, support with work setup improvement: Computer, Screen, Desk, Office Devices, Air conditioner etc.



About our company:

Our company has been founded 8 years ago in Lübeck, Germany and is mainly active in E-Commerce business. We sell tools and electrician equipment on Amazon and on our own online shop and we are the market leader in the niche. We are active on several European marketplaces with a large catalogue and many product variations, so there are a lot of listings, prices and deals to be managed. Our mission is to build a company that delivers great quality for fair prices to as many customers as possible, while at the same time providing a sustainably good work environment for our team. We are always looking to improve ourselves and to grow our business across Europe. The more we grow, the more challenges we will be facing. Therefore you should also be interested in always improving and change should not scare you.



For this job, you will need a very good and reliable internet connection as well as a properly working computer, preferably a Macbook.



If you are interested in becoming a member of our company team, we are looking forward to your application. Please make sure to include the following aspects and answer all the below questions in your application. All other applications that are not complete will be sorted out.

• Please write in detail in which way you match the required skills and personality traits.

• Please include in the Subject of your application the phrase "BST ACCOUNT" so we know you have read this job post fully.



If you believe you are a great fit, send us your application now! We are looking forward to hearing from you.



Best regards,

Anton Levkau

Bodenständig

Germany

title: Amazon UK Product Sourcer (Online Arbitrage) - Experienced UK OA Sourcers Only
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon Product Sourcer to help us grow and scale our UK Amazon FBA business. The main focus of the role is sourcing profitable products in the UK marketplace, primarily via Online Arbitrage.



WE HAVE THE CAPITAL READY TO SPEND. WHAT WE NEED IS MORE HIGH-QUALITY LEADS. That is the whole job, and it is why we are only looking for proven UK OA sourcers this time. If you are new to sourcing or have only worked the US market, this role is not for you.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR THE SAME LEADS EVERYONE ELSE BUYS. Deal lists, 
 feeds and the top page of the scanning tools are seen by hundreds of sellers on the same day and the margin is gone within hours. We want a sourcer who can MANUFACTURE THEIR OWN DISCOUNT (stacking codes, clearance, discounts and anything else to make profitable products, price matches, multi-buy and bundle offers, newsletter and app-only promotions) and who can FIND LOW-KEY LEADS that never appear on a shared list: quiet retailers, deep category pages, seasonal clearance, brands with no third-party sellers yet. If you can take a shelf price that shows 5% ROI and turn it into a 25% buy, you are who we want.



The role includes an UNCAPPED BONUS based on the spend on leads you provide. The more we buy from your leads, the more you earn. Our top performing sourcers regularly earn an extra $400+ per month on top of salary, and there is no ceiling. FOR A PROVEN, ABSOLUTE TOP PERFORMER, THE BASE SALARY IS NEGOTIABLE. Show us your track record and we will talk.



The ideal candidate is self-motivated, hungry, and looking for a long-term position with space to grow. We ask that only candidates with real experience of Online Arbitrage product sourcing in the UK marketplace apply.



WHAT AN A-CLASS SOURCER LOOKS LIKE TO US:

- Consistently delivers leads we actually buy, not long lists of borderline ones

- Manufactures margin: knows every legitimate way to get a UK retailer's price down (code stacking, cashback sites, discounted gift cards, loyalty schemes, price matching, multi-buys, app and newsletter codes etc) and builds that into the lead before submitting it

- Finds low-key leads through methods the shared tools and deal lists do not surface: manual retailer digging, storefront and reverse sourcing, deep category and clearance pages, brands with no third-party sellers, seasonal and regional stock

- Uses a wide range of sourcing methods and keeps finding new ones (retailer clearance and promotions, brand and category scanning, Keepa Product Finder)

- Reads a Keepa chart properly: real sales velocity, the real sell price, Buy Box behaviour, etc

- Checks gating, IP risk, variations and VAT before submitting, so leads arrive clean

- Knows UK retailers and discount routes that most sourcing VAs do not



EXPERIENCE REQUESTED (please include details of your experience against each point in your application):

- 12+ months experience in OA sourcing for the UK market specifically

- Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, SellerAmp SAS and Keepa

- Experience in a variety of different sourcing methods for OA (and wholesale or Amazon-to-Amazon if applicable) - list every sourcing method you have used, step by step

- Google Sheets / Excel

- Understanding of UK VAT and UK FBA fees in profit calculations



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Product research and analysis in SAS and Keepa

- Finding your own leads from UK retailers and suppliers using your full range of methods

- Verifying, prioritising and re-checking leads passed to you by the team before they are bought

- Inputting leads into our leads database in the required format, with your reasoning

- Flagging replenishable winners



WHAT WE OFFER:

- $350 / month starting base salary + uncapped performance bonus paid on spend from your leads

- Flexible working hours (40 hours per week, work when suits you, with at least a one hour crossover with UK 9am-5pm for communication)

- Salary reviewed regularly and increased based on contribution and performance; base negotiable for a proven top performer

- Career development: we are expanding our team of VAs and will be promoting internally for managers and purchasers

- Long-term, stable role with a growing UK business



REQUIREMENTS:

- Full-time: 40 hours a week

- You will use timeproof software to demonstrate you are working effectively during contracted hours

- You will work for us and only us; you may not source for other e-commerce sellers at the same time

- Every lead you submit is checked. Padded or copied lead sheets end the trial.

- Include the words "BIG CHEESE" in your application subject. Applications without it are ignored. This is to make sure you have read the post.



TO APPLY:

Respond with the subject line above and include ALL of the following. Applications missing any of these are not read:



1. A brief description of why you are the best candidate and how you can help us grow.

2. Every sourcing method you use, step by step, in your own words. Which retailers, which discount and cashback routes, which Keepa filters, how you stack them. "I use Keepa and SAS" is not an answer.

3. How you manufacture discount. Give us a real example of a deal where the shelf price did not work and you built the margin yourself: which codes, cashback, gift card or loyalty discounts you stacked, in what order, and what the final buy price and ROI came to. Legitimate, publicly available discounts only.

4. 2-3 real UK product leads you have found in the last 7 days that did NOT come from a deal list, 
 feed or the top page of a scanning tool: retailer purchase link, Amazon link, buy price including delivery and any discount applied, sell price, ROI, net profit after VAT and fees, estimated monthly sales, SAS and Keepa screenshots, how you found it, and a short description of why it is a good lead. This is mandatory, not optional, and it carries the most weight in our decision. Leads we recognise from public lists count against you.

5. Your track record: for your last one or two UK clients, roughly how much did they spend per month on your leads, and what ROI did those leads return? Do you have your old lead sheet for us to see example leads?



If you have a CV, portfolio or anything else that demonstrates why we should hire you, include it. Shortlisted candidates get a short video call and a paid two-week trial working real leads.

title: Social Media Growth & Content Manager - UK/US Brand Accounts (TikTok, Pinterest, IG, YouTube) + Editing
description:
We are hiring one person to own organic social growth across three businesses. You will join a small UK-run team that already includes a skilled video editor in the Philippines. You bring the strategy, the systems, the competitor intelligence, the daily management and your own editing hands. She takes the heavier edits and the volume; you help to direct content strategy and will also be doing some video editing/creation yourself.



THIS IS A GROWTH ROLE AND A HANDS-ON CONTENT ROLE. We want someone who can grow brand accounts for a UK or US audience and push real traffic to a website, and who can also edit and produce short-form content themselves when the calendar needs it. You will not be editing all day (that is what our editor is for), but you must be able to cut a Reel, build a pin, and turn one piece of footage into ten posts without waiting on anyone.



THE THREE BUSINESSES:

1. Havern (
) - a UK wellness brand selling herbal drops on Shopify. UK audience. Organic-first for the rest of 2026: we want to be running multiple accounts to push traffic to our site.

2. Wishes Made Easy (
) - personalised video greetings from real people, sold worldwide, with UK/US customers and a big Christmas season. Editing and posting the video clips, and creating winners for paid ads.

3. Our Amazon Influencer Program (AIP) operation - this is a bit of an extra. We also work on the Amazon Influencer Program and you may have some overlap into helping with content for this. Experience in this is beneficial but not required.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Run the brand accounts for Havern and WME: Pinterest, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts,
, Threads (and X where useful). Own the posting calendar, captions, hashtags, community replies and account hygiene.

- Drive high-volume organic output without tripping platform rules. We have scheduling tools in place; you run the calendar, approve what goes out, and keep it varied enough that platforms treat it as original.

- Make UK/US reach happen from the Philippines. This is the hard part of the job and the main thing we are hiring for. You know how to set up, warm up and settle accounts so the algorithm serves a UK or US audience, and you know why most offshore-run brand accounts end up with the wrong viewers.

- Competitor intelligence: regular teardowns of competitor socials, campaigns and paid ads (Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Pinterest trends). What hooks, formats, cadence and offers are working, and what we should adapt. Structure and pacing we learn from; claims and footage we never copy.

- Direct the editor and edit yourself: write clear briefs (hook, script beats, shot list, format, CTA), review her cuts, give sharp feedback, and iterate on what performs. Cut your own short-form edits, pins, carousels and repurposed clips in CapCut, Canva or similar when speed matters.

- Optimise for conversion, not vanity. Track what actually drives clicks, sessions and sales from each platform and adjust. Report weekly on a small set of numbers we agree together.

- AI video creation: use AI tools where they speed up assembly, variation and repurposing (voice-over, captions, cut-downs, formats) while keeping the brands demonstrably real. Experience here is a strong plus.

- AIP growth: help build the social and storefront side of our Amazon Influencer operation, source brand collaborations, and keep the pipeline of products and videos moving. Any AIP experience is a genuine advantage.



EXPERIENCE REQUESTED:

- 1+ years managing social accounts for e-commerce or DTC brands with a UK or US audience, ideally while based in the Philippines

- Proof of growth you drove: handles, starting and current followers, audience country, and your role in it

- TikTok essential; Pinterest, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels strong

- Hands-on editing: CapCut (or Premiere / DaVinci), Canva, captions, hooks, sound selection, formats for each platform. Show us work you edited yourself.

- Scheduling and analytics tools (Metricool, Buffer, Later, Postiz or similar) and the ability to read platform analytics properly

- Good written English with a natural UK/US tone; you will write captions and briefs every day

- Nice to have: an AI video stack (voice, captions, generation), Amazon Influencer Program experience, Klaviyo or
 basics, paid-social literacy



WHAT WE OFFER:

- $350 / month base to start, negotiable for proven UK/US brand-growth experience

- Uncapped monthly performance bonus on top of base, paid on results we can measure

- Bonuses are paid on real numbers only. Bots, bought followers, engagement pods or fake traffic void the bonus and end the role.

- Flexible working hours (40 hours per week, with at least a one hour crossover with UK 9am-5pm for communication)

- Salary reviewed regularly and increased based on contribution and performance

- A long-term role with real ownership across three growing businesses. If we earn more, you will - growth potential is uncapped for the role.



REQUIREMENTS:

- Full-time: 40 hours a week

- You will use timeproof software to demonstrate you are working effectively during contracted hours

- You will work for us and only us during contracted hours

- Include the word "EGG" in your application subject. Applications without it are ignored.



TO APPLY:

Respond with the subject line above and include the following. Applications missing any of these are not read:



1. The accounts you have personally grown: handle, niche, audience country, follower count when you started and now, and exactly what you did.

2. How do you make sure a UK or US brand account gets UK or US viewers when it is managed from the Philippines? Be specific about account setup, warm-up, content, timing, and what you avoid.

3. Look at 
 and its social accounts, then find one UK competitor. In 5 bullet points: what the competitor does better on social, and what you would change for Havern in your first 30 days.

4. Write one short video brief for our editor for Wishes Made Easy: hook, 3 script beats, shot list, CTA.

5. Links to 3 short-form pieces you edited yourself (TikTok, Reels or Shorts), with a line on what each was for and how it performed.

6. Which AI video tools have you used, and for what?

7. Do you have Amazon Influencer Program experience? If yes, describe it (videos, placements, Creator Connections, earnings if you can share).

8. Which scheduling and analytics tools you use, and what you report on weekly.

description:

title: Custom GPT & Claude Skills Builder — Image & Video
description:
Custom GPT & Claude Skills Builder — Image & Video



We’re looking for an experienced Custom GPT and Claude Skills builder specializing in AI image and video prompting.



Your primary responsibility will be to build advanced Custom GPTs and Claude Skills for AI image and video generation — not simply write prompts for us.



Hands-on prompt engineering experience with Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5 is required. No exceptions. If you do not have this experience please do not apply 



What You’ll Build



* Custom GPTs for AI image prompting

* Custom GPTs for AI video prompting

* Claude Skills for image and video prompting

* Model-specific prompting systems for Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro

* Model-specific prompting systems for GPT Image 2

* Model-specific prompting systems for Seedance 2.0 and 2.5

* Reference-image analysis and recreation workflows

* Photorealistic image prompting systems

* Character and identity consistency workflows

* Image-to-image prompting systems

* Video shot and scene builders

* Multi-shot video prompting systems

* Prompt troubleshooting and optimization workflows

* Supporting knowledge bases, instructions and SOPs



Required Prompt Engineering Experience



You must have proven, hands-on prompt engineering experience with:



* Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro

* GPT Image 2

* Seedance 2.0

* Seedance 2.5



You should understand advanced image and video prompting, including:



* Photorealistic image generation

* Reference-image prompting and recreation

* Character and identity consistency

* Natural skin, hair and human realism

* Composition, framing and perspective

* Camera angles, lenses and lighting

* Image-to-image generation

* Camera movement and cinematography

* Character movement and action

* Shot construction

* Multi-shot sequences

* Scene-to-scene consistency

* Diagnosing failed generations and correcting prompts



You must understand that different generation models require different prompting methodologies. We are not looking for generic prompts repurposed across every model.



Custom GPT & Claude Skills Development



You must have experience building Custom GPTs and/or Claude Skills and understand how to turn expert prompting knowledge into a system other people can use.



This includes:



* System instructions and prompting architecture

* Knowledge files and supporting resources

* Model-specific prompting logic

* Structured user intake

* Reference-image analysis

* Prompt construction workflows

* Quality-control and self-checking logic

* Troubleshooting workflows

* Prompt revision and optimization

* Maintaining and improving the systems as models evolve



The finished GPTs and Skills should be capable of taking a user’s idea or reference image, understanding the desired output and generation model, and producing a high-quality prompt engineered specifically for that model.



For video, the systems must understand how to translate an idea or reference into properly structured shots, scenes, camera direction, movement, action and sequencing for Seedance.



Testing Is Part of the Role



You will be expected to test the Custom GPTs and Claude Skills against the actual generation models, review the resulting images and videos, identify failures, refine the underlying instructions and prompting logic, and retest.



We are looking for someone who can independently take these systems from initial build → testing → refinement → production-ready workflow.



To Apply



Please provide:



1. Examples of Custom GPTs and/or Claude Skills you’ve built

2. Examples of image or video prompting GPTs/Skills, if available

4. GPT Image 2 prompts + resulting images

5. Seedance 2.0/2.5 prompts + resulting videos

6. A short explanation of how you would structure an image/video prompting GPT

7. Your availability

8. Your hourly or project rate



Do not apply if your experience is limited to general ChatGPT prompting. We need someone with proven AI image and video prompt-engineering experience who can build that expertise directly into Custom GPTs and Claude Skills.

 or similar for review/feedback

title: Amazon FBA Sourcing Assistant — Supplier Outreach & Product Research (Full-time, Long-term)
description:
Hello,



We're GTDISTRIBUTION, an Amazon FBA seller operating across 5 European marketplaces (France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Netherlands). We're growing fast and looking for a second Virtual Assistant to join our sourcing team.



What you'll actually do



1. Supplier outreach — 60% of your time

Find wholesalers and distributors in Europe and the US, contact them by
, follow up, and qualify their offers. The goal is building a portfolio of recurring products we can reorder every month — not one-off deals.



2. Product research — 40%

Identify profitable products using clear criteria we'll teach you: minimum ROI, monthly sales volume, price history analysis. You'll work from a documented process — no guessing.



What this isn't



This isn't a data-entry job. You'll be talking to suppliers, negotiating terms, and making judgment calls. If you want a role where you just fill spreadsheets, this isn't it.



Where this can go



This isn't a fixed role. Our first VA started with product research only — she now runs supplier relationships and will personally train you.



If you perform, within 12 months you could be managing your own sourcing portfolio, leading supplier negotiations directly, or training VAs for our coaching clients (we run an Amazon coaching business alongside this one).



We're looking for someone who wants to grow into a role, not just fill one.

title: Meta Creative Strategist & AI Ad Creator
description:
We run a growing portfolio of consumer brands in the New Age/western spiritual space, and we are looking for someone to help own our Meta advertising creative.



This is NOT a normal graphic design job. And I am NOT looking for Meta ads management.



If you are looking for a role where someone gives you a headline, image and exact instructions and you make it look nice, this is probably not for you.



We are looking for someone who can:



Research → Ideate → Create → Analyze → Iterate



You should be able to understand an offer and its customer, develop your own advertising angles, write strong hooks, create visual assets using AI, turn them into finished ads in Figma, and then learn from the performance data.



Your main responsibility will be creating high-performing Meta ad concepts, primarily static ads.



You will:



Research customers, competitors and advertising trends.



Study Meta Ad Library.



Develop new hooks, angles and creative concepts.



Write short direct-response headlines and copy.



Create finished static ads in Figma.



Use Google Gemini / Nano Banana Pro heavily for image generation, editing and creative production.



Use ChatGPT and other AI tools for research and ideation.



Create meaningful variations of winning ads.



Review Meta performance data.



Identify patterns in winners and losers.



Build new creative tests based on what we learn.



We do NOT want 20 versions of the same ad with slightly different colors.



We want genuinely different advertising ideas.



Our ads may include AI-generated imagery, testimonials, screenshots, text messages, native social posts, reviews, editorial or news-style concepts, curiosity-driven ads, emotional direct-response ads, simple text-heavy ads, highly designed ads, and deliberately ugly or native-looking ads.



The best ad is the one that performs.



Not the one that looks prettiest.



Our brands operate within areas such as tarot readings, psychic readings, love and relationship guidance, astrology, spirituality, manifestation, personal insight, and celestial or seasonal events.



You do NOT need to personally believe in tarot or astrology.



You DO need to be comfortable working in this niche and interested in understanding the psychology of the customer.



Our preferred stack is:



Figma — main design tool.



Google Gemini / Nano Banana Pro — heavily used for generating and manipulating visual assets.



ChatGPT and other AI tools — research, ideation, hooks and creative development.



Meta Ad Library — research.



Video skills are a bonus.



If you can also make simple 15–30 second ads using CapCut or Premiere, b-roll, AI voiceovers, slideshows or animated statics, that is valuable.



However, creative strategy and static ads are the priority.



The most important part of this role is that we need someone who can THINK OF THE ADS, not just make them.



Eventually, we want you to be able to come to us and say:



“This angle is outperforming the others. I think this is why. Here are six new concepts I want to test next.”



That is much more valuable to us than perfect Photoshop technique.



You are probably a good fit if:



You understand direct-response advertising.



You constantly notice interesting ads.



You enjoy thinking about why people click and buy.



You can generate lots of different creative ideas.



You can write strong hooks and headlines.



You are good with Figma.



You are very comfortable using AI.



You move quickly.



You like testing ideas.



You are comfortable being judged by performance data.



You are not emotionally attached to your designs.



Experience creating paid
 or Instagram advertising is strongly preferred.



Experience with ecommerce, DTC, digital products, info products, lead generation or performance marketing is also useful.



You are probably NOT a good fit if:



Your background is mainly logos and branding.



You need detailed creative briefs for every ad.



Your main goal is making everything look beautiful.



You dislike writing copy.



You rarely use AI tools.



You do not care about advertising psychology.



You are not interested in performance data.



This is intended to be a long-term, full-time role.



We operate multiple brands and test significant volumes of advertising creative.



Someone who becomes genuinely good at finding winning creative concepts will have substantial room to grow with us and take on increasing responsibility across the portfolio.



How to apply:



1. Send your portfolio, especially paid
 or Meta static ads.



2. Send your three best ads.



For each one, briefly tell us:



What was the angle?



Who was the customer?



Why did you think it would work?



Do you know how it performed?



3. Tell us about your Figma experience and how regularly you use it.



4. Tell us about your AI workflow.



What image-generation or editing tools do you use?



We are particularly interested in experience with Google Gemini / Nano Banana Pro.



Tell us what you actually use AI for rather than simply saying you know how to use it.



5. If you can create short-form video ads, include your three best examples.



6. Find ONE Meta ad currently running from any company that you think is excellent.



Send us the ad or a screenshot and explain why you think it works.



This part of the application is important.



7. Start your application with the words:



PURPLE TAROT



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



Strong applicants will be invited to complete a short paid creative test.

title: Post-Production Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer
description:
Full-time | Remote

Salary: PHP 40,000 per month

The Coaches Business Studio



About the role



The Coaches Business Studio is building a digital education platform for professional coaches, delivered primarily through an AI faculty.



Our Course Producers create the core presenter videos using platforms such as HeyGen and Synthesia. We are now looking for a specialist Post-Production Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer to take those videos from the initial AI-generated output through to polished, engaging finished content.



This is not primarily an AI video-generation role. Your focus will be what happens after the presenter video has been created.



You will be responsible for the visual craft of our videos: editing, B-roll, typography, titles, motion graphics, on-screen text, transitions, diagrams and visual pacing.



We want someone who understands that great motion design is often about restraint. Our aim is not to make every moment move. It is to create videos that feel clean, intelligent, contemporary and consistent.



The Studio’s quality philosophy is that production should support the learner rather than compete for their attention.



What you’ll do



You will receive AI presenter footage produced by our Course Producer, together with scripts, scene breakdowns and visual directions.



Your responsibilities will include:



Editing AI presenter footage into polished final videos

Creating motion graphics in Adobe After Effects or similar platforms

Creating B-roll using AI video generation

Adding appropriate B-roll and supplementary footage

Designing and animating titles, headings and key phrases

Creating simple diagrams, frameworks, comparisons and process animations

Adding screenshots, illustrations and supporting visual assets

Creating elegant transitions between scenes

Using punch-ins, reframing and other editing techniques where appropriate

Integrating music and sound design when required

Ensuring consistent typography, sizing, spacing and animation behaviour

Maintaining visual consistency across a series or programme

Developing reusable After Effects templates and graphic systems

Exporting finished videos to the required specifications

Reviewing completed videos and identifying opportunities to improve pacing, clarity or visual communication



You will also help us gradually establish a clear post-production system for each member of our AI faculty, including consistent approaches to typography, graphics, B-roll and visual treatment.



The visual style we are looking for



One of the reasons we are creating this role is that we want greater visual discipline.



We are specifically looking for someone who understands that professional post-production does not mean adding more things.



We want:



fewer fonts, used consistently

purposeful rather than constant movement

clean and restrained motion graphics

strong visual hierarchy

intelligent typography

graphics that clarify ideas

B-roll that genuinely supports the narrative

thoughtful pacing

consistency across videos

subtle variation between faculty members without creating visual chaos



A good editor should sometimes watch a section and d
 that the best thing to add is nothing.



Our internal visual-production guidance describes the desired style as “thoughtful, clean, human, intelligent and practical,” with clarity prioritised over decoration.



What you’ll work on



The Studio produces several kinds of content, including:



educational course videos

YouTube videos

short-form social media videos

programme trailers

faculty introduction videos

explainer videos

framework and model animations

promotional content



Some videos may be largely presenter-led with only occasional visual support. Others may require substantially more motion graphics, B-roll or visual storytelling.



Your judgement about the difference will be important.



Essential skills



We’re looking for someone with strong practical experience in:



Adobe After Effects

Adobe Premiere Pro

motion graphics

video editing

typography for video

titles and lower thirds

B-roll integration

visual storytelling

pacing and rhythm

working with brand guidelines

organising video projects and assets



You should be comfortable creating motion graphics yourself rather than relying entirely on templates.



You should also have a strong eye for design and be able to recognise when a video feels visually busy, inconsistent or over-produced.



Particularly valuable experience



It would be useful, though not essential, if you have experience with:



educational or training videos

YouTube content

talking-head or presenter-led content

AI-generated video

HeyGen or Synthesia

animated diagrams and frameworks

social media video

sound design

colour correction

Photoshop or Illustrator

building reusable After Effects template systems

How the role fits into the team



You will work closely with our Course Producer.



The workflow will broadly be:



Course Architect → Course Producer → Post-Production Editor → Review



The Course Producer will create and refine the AI presenter performance, including voice, delivery, pronunciation, lip-sync and scene generation.



You will then take those scenes and create the finished visual experience.



This separation allows the Producer to concentrate on getting the AI performance right while you concentrate on specialist editing, motion design and visual polish.



You may also work directly with our Course Architect when a particular framework, model or teaching idea needs to be communicated visually.



We work as an integrated Studio rather than a production line. Editors are encouraged to notice when a graphic is unnecessary, when a visual could explain something better, or when removing something would improve the finished lesson. That kind of contribution is explicitly part of how we want the team to work.



What good looks like



After a few weeks, we would expect to see:



significantly more polished finished videos

consistent fonts and typography

recognisable graphic systems

fewer unnecessary animations

better use of B-roll

stronger visual hierarchy

clear stylistic consistency within each faculty member’s content

reusable animation templates that speed up future production

a recognisable visual identity emerging across The Coaches Business Studio

less post-production work being carried by the Course Producer



Most importantly, the editing should make the teaching easier and more enjoyable to follow.



The person we’re looking for



We are likely to work well together if you:



care about the details of your craft

have strong visual taste

can explain why you have made a creative decision

are comfortable receiving feedback

can distinguish personal preference from good design

enjoy creating systems as well as individual videos

take ownership of the finished result

notice inconsistencies without waiting for someone else to point them out

enjoy experimenting without becoming attached to every experiment



We are building something new, so we value curiosity and initiative alongside technical skill.



Salary and working arrangement



This is a full-time remote position.



Salary: PHP 40,000 per month.



You will work as part of the core production team at The Coaches Business Studio.



Applying



Please send:



your CV or résumé

a link to your portfolio or showreel

3 examples of work that best demonstrate your motion graphics and editing skills

a brief explanation of what you personally created in each example

examples of educational, presenter-led or talking-head editing if you have them



Shortlisted applicants may be given a small paid editing exercise using one of our existing AI presenter videos.

Training & Development Budget

Government-Mandated Benefits/ HMO

Job Overview: 

As a Key Account Manager for IT Managed Services customers, you will be at the forefront of this mission, acting as a trusted partner and advisor to our valued clients.



You will be instrumental in ensuring their continued success, identifying opportunities for them to leverage technology more effectively. This role is about building lasting relationships, driving mutual growth, and ensuring our clients experience the "Amazon Prime" of IT service — effortless, responsive, and world class.



You will be directly accountable for key accounts, client retention, satisfaction, and the growth of your assigned accounts, contributing significantly to itGenius's 10-year goal of becoming the global leader in remote-delivered IT services to the SMB market.





Accountabilities:

The Key Account Manager is specifically accountable for the following measurable objectives within their assigned client portfolio:



* Holding the Game Plan: Accountable for holding a client’s long-term objectives and ensuring the plan is constantly moved forward over time via quarterly reviews.



* Client Partnership: Holding relationships with key decision-makers within assigned client accounts, positioning itGenius as a trusted technology partner.



* Client Retention & Satisfaction: Accountable for maintaining high levels of client satisfaction and ensuring the retention of assigned client accounts.



* Revenue Growth: Accountable for identifying and securing opportunities for revenue growth through upsell and cross-sell within their assigned client portfolio.



Key Responsibilities: 

To achieve the above accountabilities, the Key Account Manager will perform the following day-to-day activities:



* Relationship Management: Proactively engage with assigned clients through regular meetings (virtual and in-person where appropriate), calls, and
 communications to understand their evolving business needs and technology landscape.



* Needs Assessment & Solution Proposal: Conduct thorough needs analyses to identify client challenges and opportunities, and present tailored IT solutions and services that align with their strategic objectives and our service offerings.



* Sales & Negotiation: Prepare and deliver proposals, negotiate contracts, and manage the sales cycle for upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts to achieve revenue targets.



* Client Advocacy & Issue Resolution: Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, advocating for their needs internally and collaborating with the technical, support, and project teams to ensure timely and effective resolution of any issues or escalations.



* Billing & Account Administration: Chase unpaid invoices, resolve billing queries, and manage account reconciliations for assigned clients.



* Cancellations & Offboarding: Oversee the cancellation and offboarding process for departing clients, ensuring a professional handover and capturing lessons for retention.



* Account Planning & Review: Develop and maintain comprehensive account plans for each assigned client, including key contacts, service history, future opportunities, and conduct regular business reviews to demonstrate value and align on future strategies.



* CRM Management & Reporting: Maintain accurate and up-to-date client information, communication logs, and sales pipeline data within the CRM system. Prepare and present regular reports on account health, sales performance, and client satisfaction to the Head of Sales & Accounts.



* Market Awareness: Stay informed about industry trends, technological advancements, and the competitive landscape to better advise clients and identify new opportunities.

 



Required Qualifications & Skills: 



Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, IT, or related field

5–8+ years in account management, sales, or client services, ideally in IT/technology/SaaS. 

Experience in an MSP environment or familiarity with managed IT services delivery is an advantage.

Proven track record in client retention, revenue growth, and account expansion.

Client Relationship & Strategy: Build trusted partnerships with senior decision-makers. Develop account plans, conduct business reviews, and identify growth opportunities.

Sales & Solution Selling: Skilled in proposal creation, contract negotiation, upsell/cross-sell, and delivering tailored IT solutions.

Communication & Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written skills; adept at presenting to executives and working seamlessly with internal teams.

CRM & Reporting: Proficient in CRM tools for tracking accounts, pipeline management, and reporting on KPIs.

Leadership & Mentoring: Mentor junior account managers and contribute to process improvements.

Behavioral Competencies: Proactive, innovative, accountable, collaborative, and trusted.



Work Schedule

8-hour shift

Mid-Shift 

Monday to Friday

Weekends off

Observance of Philippine holiday

Permanent Work Form Home

You’ll thrive here if you’re interested in:

The evolving world of cloud-based work (Google Workspace, Google Drive, Gmail, etc.)

Supporting small business growth (1–30 employees)

Applying technology to improve productivity and collaboration

Our video team is one of the engines behind that growth; the ads we ship directly drive revenue, and we're scaling the team accordingly.



The Role

We're looking for a Video Editor to produce high-performing, direct-response video ads for our paid social channels. You'll turn briefs, hooks, insights, and raw footage into scroll-stopping, conversion-focused content executed with speed, precision, and a performance mindset. You'll work closely with our creative strategy team, iterate fast based on real performance data, and use AI-powered tools to move quicker without cutting corners on quality.
