title: E-Commerce Product Researcher – Funnel-Focused Products, Meta ads
description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce business building and scaling direct-response brands across multiple markets.



As we expand into new countries and launch additional products, we are seeking an expert Product Researcher who understands how to identify products specifically suited to high-converting sales funnels and dedicated landing pages.



This is not a standard dropshipping product research role focused on finding products to upload directly to Shopify product pages.



We are looking for funnel-focused products that can be sold through a dedicated customer journey, typically moving from a paid social advertisement to an advertorial or listicle and then to a high-converting landing page or sales funnel.



We are willing to pay well for someone with genuine expertise who can consistently identify high-quality opportunities rather than submit large lists of random products.



### Job Responsibilities



* Research and identify high-potential products suited to sales funnels, advertorials, listicles and dedicated landing pages.

* Find products with strong direct-response potential that can be marketed around a clear problem, desire, transformation or unique angle.

* Research products that are already demonstrating demand while identifying opportunities that have not yet become completely saturated.

* Use the
 Ad Library extensively to 
 competitors, active advertisements, creative angles, advertorials, listicles, landing pages, offers and brands that are currently scaling.

* Use TrendTrack and other current product and trend research platforms to identify emerging products and opportunities.

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and other relevant platforms to expand product research, discover alternative keywords, identify product terminology, uncover customer problems, explore niche terminology and generate competitor search terms.

* Go beyond obvious product names when researching. We expect you to uncover different keywords, synonyms, problem-based searches and marketing angles that help reveal products others may miss.

* Analyse competitor funnels from the advertisement through to the advertorial or listicle, landing page, offer structure, bundles and upsells.

* Identify products with strong potential for bundling and increasing average order value.

* Prioritise shipping-friendly products, ideally smaller and lightweight items that are inexpensive and straightforward to fulfil internationally.

* Avoid products that are excessively large, fragile, extremely heavy or otherwise difficult and expensive to ship.

* Evaluate sourcing opportunities, approximate product costs, perceived value, potential selling prices and available margins.

* Research whether multiple quantities, bundles or complementary products could create stronger offers.

* Provide clear reasoning behind every product recommendation rather than simply submitting product links.

* Stay up to date with changing advertising trends, winning funnels, emerging niches, competitor strategies and new research tools.

* Communicate and collaborate effectively through Slack, which is required for day-to-day team communication and project updates.



### What We Are Looking For



We are specifically seeking an experienced e-commerce product researcher, not someone looking to learn product research from scratch.



You should have:



* Proven experience researching winning or scalable e-commerce products.

* Strong experience researching products designed to be sold through funnels, advertorials, listicles and dedicated landing pages rather than standard Shopify product pages alone.

* Expert knowledge of the
 Ad Library and the ability to conduct deep competitor research rather than basic searches.

* Experience using TrendTrack or similar modern product and advertising research platforms.

* A strong understanding of direct-response marketing and what makes a product suitable for a funnel.

* A solid understanding of product-market fit, customer pain points, emotional buying triggers and marketing angles.

* The ability to distinguish between a product that simply looks interesting and one that could realistically support a profitable advertising campaign.

* A strong understanding of bundles, quantity breaks, upsells and offer creation.

* The ability to assess shipping considerations, sourcing costs, margins and perceived product value.

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and other relevant platforms for advanced research, including generating search terms, alternative keywords, niche terminology and research directions.

* Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.

* Fluent English and the ability to clearly explain why you believe a product has potential.

* Familiarity with Slack and the ability to use it reliably for communication, collaboration and sharing research updates.

* A proactive mindset. We do not want someone who needs to be told exactly which keywords to search or where to look.

* Please include word 'blue' in your application so we know you have read and understood the job post fully.



### Exclusivity & Confidentiality



This is extremely important to us.



We do not want someone simultaneously researching and supplying the same products or opportunities to other e-commerce businesses.



The products, competitors, funnels, niches and opportunities you discover while working with us must remain confidential.



You will be required to sign an NDA or confidentiality agreement before beginning work with us.



We are looking to build a long-term relationship with someone who becomes an important part of our product development and scaling process.



### Compensation & Growth



We are willing to pay for expertise.



We are not looking for the cheapest product researcher available. If you can consistently identify genuinely strong products and opportunities, we are happy to compensate you accordingly.



Compensation can be structured around experience, workload and results.



This is not intended to be a short-term position.



Our team is growing rapidly, and we are expanding into additional international markets. As a result, our need for product research will continue to increase.



For the right person, there is significant room to grow with the company, take on greater responsibility and become a key part of our wider product research and development operation.



### What We Value



We want someone who:



* Thinks independently.

* Understands direct-response e-commerce.

* Is naturally curious and enjoys digging deeper than competitors.

* Keeps up with the latest research tools and methods.

* Can recognise trends early.

* Understands that quality is more important than quantity.

* Can explain the reasoning and evidence behind every recommendation.

* Communicates consistently and effectively through Slack.

* Wants to work long-term with a growing e-commerce team.



### How to Apply



If you believe you are an expert e-commerce product researcher, we would like to hear from you.



Please include:



* Your previous product research experience.

* The research tools you currently use.

* Your experience with the
 Ad Library.

* Your experience with TrendTrack or similar platforms.

* How you identify products suitable for funnels, advertorials or listicles rather than standard product pages.

* Examples of products you have previously discovered that went on to perform successfully, where possible.

* How you use AI within your product research workflow.

* Your familiarity and experience with Slack.

* Your availability and preferred compensation structure.

* The word “blue” to confirm that you have read and understood this job post fully.



Please do not send a generic application.



We are looking for someone who already understands advanced product research and can demonstrate a clear process for finding products with genuine funnel and scaling potential.



If you are excellent at finding opportunities before everyone else does and want to become part of a growing e-commerce team expanding into new markets, we would love to hear from you.

title: Editorial Content Writer
description:
We are a fast-growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand looking for an exceptionally sharp, articulate Editorial Product Reviewer & AI Content Editor.



In this role, you will write in-depth, third-party review articles, head-to-head product comparisons, and comprehensive breakdown blogs to be published across external media outlets and review platforms. Our audience is highly intelligent, discerning, and extremely skeptical. They instantly spot overt marketing hype, shallow buzzwords, and fake praise.

Your goal is to write legitimate, highly credible, analytical product reviews that provide real substance, address actual pros and cons, and earn the reader's trust through genuine editorial depth.



We do not accept raw AI slop. If your workflow is pasting a prompt into ChatGPT, copying the output, and calling it a day, this job is not for you. I can spot low-effort AI writing immediately (robotic tone, generic filler phrases, canned intros, and superficial conclusions loaded with words like "delve," "game-changer," or "testament").



We need an editor who uses AI strictly as a tool for initial research, outlines, and structural velocity, but uses their own journalistic critical thinking to strip away the fluff, rewrite the copy, and deliver a polished, authentic piece that reads exactly like a deep-dive review from a top-tier tech or lifestyle publication.



Core Responsibilities

• Deep-Dive Review Writing: Produce realistic, objective-sounding product reviews, multi-product roundups, and side-by-side feature comparisons for off-site publication.

• AI-Assisted Drafting: Utilize modern LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) to rapidly organize product specs, outline key arguments, and generate initial rough drafts.

• Deep Humanization & Editing: Completely gut AI linguistic markers. Inject natural sentence cadence, nuanced critique, balanced pros/cons, and authentic observational detail.

• Nuanced Positioning: Translate complex product specs and technical mechanisms into relatable, real-world experience without sounding like a sales rep.

• Structural Excellence: Format articles with clean subheadings, practical verdict summaries, pros/cons lists, and logical breakdown structures that respect a smart reader's time.



Required Qualifications & Skills

• Flawless Editorial & Review Skills: Exceptional command of written English with a background in digital journalism, technical reviewing, or high-level blogging.

• Critical Eye for Marketing Hype: You know how to discuss a product's strengths authentically while maintaining the critical, balanced distance of an independent reviewer.

• Advanced AI Prompting: Experience directing AI tools using explicit constraints, style parameters, and detailed reference briefs rather than basic prompts.

• Obsessive AI Slop Detector: You instinctively catch robotic phrasing, repetitive sentence patterns, and hollow generalizations—and you know how to completely humanize them.

• Reliable Setup: High-speed internet (with a backup) and a dependable workspace to consistently hit delivery deadlines.

Nice-to-Haves (Not Mandatory)

• Journalism / Technical Writing Background: Experience writing for tech publications, consumer testing sites, or niche editorial blogs.

• Affiliate / Publisher Writing: Prior experience drafting real-world buyer's guides or product breakdown articles for online publications.



How to Apply

If you are sharp, highly critical of bad writing, and know how to write nuanced product reviews that intelligent readers actually trust, please reply with 2–3 links or attachments of review-style articles, buyer's guides, or editorial breakdowns you have written. (Before/After samples showing a raw AI draft versus your final humanized piece are strongly encouraged and will jump to the top).

title: Meta Ads Creative Strategist
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing Shopify direct-to-consumer (DTC) sleep technology brand, and we are looking for a highly analytical, sharp, and proactive Creative Strategist for Meta Ads.



To be incredibly clear: This is NOT a graphic design or video editing role. You will not be pushing pixels in Figma or editing timelines in Premiere.



You are the architect of our ad account. Your job is to conduct deep market research, understand consumer psychology, develop high-converting direct response (DR) angles, and write airtight creative briefs for our design and editing teams. You must understand why people buy and know how to structure a scroll-stopping hook and a persuasive script that sells.



If you are someone who waits to be handed a list of ideas to brief, or if you just guess what might look "cool" without looking at the data, this is not the role for you. We need a strategic powerhouse who owns the creative testing roadmap from insight to execution to analysis.



Core Responsibilities

- Deep Avatar & Market Research: Obsessively research our target demographic. You will scour competitor ad libraries, mine customer reviews, read Reddit threads, and analyze TikTok comments to uncover hidden pain points and desires.  

- Angle & Concept Ideation: Develop original, direct response advertising angles. You will translate your research into structured concepts (e.g., problem/solution, Us vs. Them, scientific proof/temperature control comparisons, emotional triggers). 

- Airtight Creative Briefing: Write highly detailed, idiot-proof creative briefs and video scripts for our designers and editors. Your briefs must clearly define the hook, the visual layout, the on-screen text, the pacing, and the core CTA.  

- Creative Performance Analysis: You won't just launch briefs and forget them. You will actively analyze performance data in Meta Ads Manager and our attribution software (e.g., Northbeam, Triple Whale) to diagnose hook rates, thumb-stop ratios, and CPA. You must be able to explain why an ad won or lost.  

- Testing Roadmap Management: Build and manage our weekly creative testing pipeline, ensuring a consistent flow of fresh concepts, iterative variations of winning ads, and new format tests.  



Required Qualifications & Skills

- Direct Response Mastery is Mandatory: You must have a deep, proven understanding of what makes a Meta ad convert. You know the anatomy of a winning ad, consumer psychology, and how to structure a pitch that drives immediate action.

- Exceptional Copywriting & Scripting: Flawless written English. You must be able to write punchy, persuasive video scripts, ad copy, and headlines that resonate with a US-based consumer.

- Data Literacy: You must be comfortable reading data. You know the difference between a creative problem (low hook rate) and a landing page problem (high CTR, low CVR), and you use that data to guide your next brief.

- Proactive & Independent: You do not need to be micromanaged. You independently spot fatigue in our ad account, research what competitors are scaling, and pitch your own concepts.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable computer.



Nice-to-Haves (Not Mandatory)

- Prior experience strategizing for sleep-tech, health/wellness, or high-AOV premium home goods brands.

- Familiarity with creative research and saving tools like Foreplay or Atria.



How to Apply:

If you are sharp, obsessed with consumer psychology, and ready to be the brains behind our Meta ad engine, please reply with:

- A link to a portfolio or Google Drive folder containing 2–3 examples of creative briefs or scripts you have written that resulted in profitable ads, and the images/videos of those ads (if available).

title: SEO Blog Content Writer & Content Strategist – Webflow + Canva
description:
We are looking for a **creative, SEO-focused blog writer and content strategist** who can take ownership of our ongoing website content.



This role is not simply about being handed a topic and writing an article. We need someone who understands **how to research keywords, identify topics worth ranking for, build a long-term content plan, write engaging and useful articles, create supporting graphics, and publish finished content directly to our website.**



The ideal person is both **creative and analytical**. You should be able to look at our business, services, target customers, and competitors and develop a roadmap of blog topics designed to increase organic traffic and generate leads.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



### SEO Keyword & Topic Research



* Research keywords relevant to our services, customers, and geographic markets.

* Identify search terms with realistic ranking opportunities.

* Understand search intent and determine what someone is actually looking for when searching a keyword.

* Find long-tail keyword opportunities and supporting topics.

* Research competitor websites and identify content gaps.

* Determine which topics should be prioritized based on traffic potential, competition, and business value.



### Content Strategy & Blog Mapping



You should be comfortable creating an organized **content roadmap rather than writing random individual blog posts.**



This includes:



* Creating monthly and quarterly blog topic plans.

* Building topic clusters around our primary services.

* Identifying pillar articles and supporting articles.

* Mapping related articles together for internal linking.

* Avoiding keyword cannibalization between articles.

* Developing location-specific content when appropriate.

* Planning evergreen content as well as seasonal or timely content.

* Recommending updates to older articles when opportunities exist.



We want someone who can essentially say:



**"Here are the keywords we should target, here are the articles we should create around them, and here is the order we should publish them."**



## Blog Writing



You will be responsible for writing polished, engaging articles that are both **optimized for search engines and enjoyable for real people to read.**



Articles should include:



* Strong SEO-friendly titles.

* Clear introductions that quickly answer the reader's question.

* Logical H1, H2, and H3 structure.

* Natural keyword placement.

* Related keywords and supporting topics.

* Internal links to relevant website pages and blog posts.

* Appropriate external references when necessary.

* Calls to action that naturally lead readers toward our services.

* Meta titles and meta descriptions.

* Suggested URL slugs.

* Image alt text.

* FAQ sections when appropriate.



Content should never feel robotic, repetitive, overly keyword-stuffed, or written simply to satisfy an SEO checklist.



## Creative Writing Ability



We want someone capable of understanding the personality of a business and writing content that sounds **natural, knowledgeable, professional, and approachable.**



You should be able to:



* Take technical or boring subjects and make them interesting.

* Develop strong hooks and introductions.

* Tell stories when appropriate.

* Explain complicated subjects simply.

* Match an existing company's voice and writing style.

* Understand the difference between educational content and promotional content.

* Write content designed to build trust rather than constantly selling.

* Come up with creative angles for subjects that competitors may already be covering.



## Webflow Experience



You should have experience working with **Webflow CMS** or be comfortable learning and working directly inside a structured CMS.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating new blog posts inside Webflow.

* Formatting headings, paragraphs, lists, links, and images.

* Selecting categories and tags.

* Adding SEO titles and meta descriptions.

* Creating clean URL slugs.

* Adding featured images.

* Adding image alt descriptions.

* Previewing articles before publishing.

* Checking desktop and mobile formatting.

* Connecting internal links throughout the website.

* Scheduling or publishing completed articles.



You should be comfortable working independently inside an established website without a
 changing unrelated website elements.



## Canva & Basic Graphic Design



Blog posts will also require supporting imagery.



You should have experience using **Canva or similar design software** to create professional-looking blog graphics.



This may include:



* Combining multiple photos into one graphic.

* Creating featured blog images.

* Cropping and resizing photographs.

* Adding text overlays when appropriate.

* Removing or replacing backgrounds.

* Creating simple comparison graphics.

* Creating informational graphics.

* Maintaining consistent fonts, branding, spacing, and visual style.

* Exporting properly optimized images for web use.



You do not need to be a professional graphic designer, but you should have **a good visual eye and understand what makes something look polished and professional.**



## Understanding of Modern SEO



Candidates should understand concepts including:



* Keyword research.

* Search intent.

* Long-tail keywords.

* Keyword difficulty.

* Search volume.

* Topical authority.

* Content clusters.

* Internal linking.

* On-page SEO.

* Local SEO.

* Meta descriptions.

* Title tags.

* Image optimization.

* Alt text.

* Featured snippets.

* FAQ content.

* Competitor research.

* Content gap analysis.

* Updating and refreshing existing content.



Experience with SEO tools such as **Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Keyword Planner, Screaming Frog, or similar platforms** is strongly preferred.



## AI-Assisted Writing



We are comfortable with AI tools being used as part of the research and writing process.



However, we are **not looking for someone who simply generates an article with AI and publishes it.**



The person in this role must know how to:



* Research and verify information.

* Fact-check AI-generated material.

* Rewrite content so it sounds natural.

* Remove generic or repetitive AI language.

* Add original insight and business-specific information.

* Maintain a consistent company voice.

* Recognize when AI-generated information is inaccurate.

* Use AI as a productivity tool rather than a replacement for writing and strategy.



## Required Skills



The ideal candidate will have:



* Strong English writing and grammar skills.

* Previous SEO blog-writing experience.

* Experience performing keyword and competitor research.

* Experience creating content calendars or SEO content strategies.

* Understanding of search intent.

* Experience publishing content through a CMS.

* Webflow experience or strong experience with similar CMS platforms.

* Canva or basic graphic-design experience.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently.

* Ability to meet deadlines and maintain an organized content schedule.

* Ability to research unfamiliar industries and quickly understand them.

* Ability to follow an established brand voice.



## Strong Candidates Will Also Understand



* Local-service SEO.

* Service-area businesses.

* Conversion-focused website writing.

* Google Business Profile strategy.

* Schema and structured content.

* Google Search Console.

* Google Analytics.

* Content performance reporting.

* Basic image SEO.

* Basic website UX.

* Content repurposing for social media.

* How blog content supports service and landing pages.



## What We Don't Want



We are not looking for someone who:



* Only writes when given an exact topic.

* Depends entirely on AI-generated articles.

* Produces generic 500-word SEO posts.

* Keyword-stuffs articles.

* Copies competitor content.

* Publishes articles without checking formatting.

* Requires detailed instructions for every assignment.

* Focuses exclusively on search volume without understanding whether a keyword could actually generate customers.



We want someone who can **think strategically and bring ideas to us.**



## Example of the Workflow



A typical project may look like this:



1. Review one of our primary services.

2. Research keywords and competing websites.

3. Identify 10–30 potential article opportunities.

4. Organize those articles into a content cluster.

5. Recommend which articles should be written first.

6. Write the article.

7. Create or prepare the supporting images.

8. Optimize the article for SEO.

9. Add internal links.

10. Publish the article in Webflow.

11. Review the finished page on desktop and mobile.

12. Track performance and recommend future content based on results.



## When Applying



Please include:



* Examples of blog articles you have written.

* Examples of websites where you have published content.

* Your experience with SEO keyword research.

* SEO tools you regularly use.

* Your experience with Webflow.

* Examples of graphics you have created in Canva.

* An example of a content calendar, keyword map, or content strategy you have created.

* A short explanation of how you d
 whether a keyword is worth targeting.

* Your preferred pricing structure: hourly, per article, or monthly retainer.



### Bonus Application Question



Imagine we are trying to rank a local service business for a competitive primary keyword.



Briefly explain how you would turn that **one main keyword into a 3-month blog content strategy.**



We are specifically looking for someone who can combine **SEO strategy + creative writing + visual content + Webflow publishing** and become an ongoing part of our content marketing process.

title: Senior Graphic Designer & Photoshop Artist
description:
# Senior Graphic Designer & Photoshop Artist



We are looking for a **high-level Senior Graphic Designer and Photoshop Artist** with exceptional creative ability, advanced photo-editing skills, and a strong understanding of professional visual design.



This is **not an entry-level position** and is not a role for someone who primarily relies on Canva templates, pre-made designs, or AI-generated artwork.



We are looking for someone who can start with raw photographs, brand assets, logos, text, and a creative direction and build a **polished, professional finished design from scratch using Adobe Photoshop and other professional Adobe tools.**



You should be equally comfortable creating a completely new design as you are taking an existing image and transforming it into something dramatically better.



## What You'll Be Creating



Projects may include:



* Website graphics

* Blog featured images

* Social media graphics

* Advertising graphics

* Promotional materials

* Event graphics

* Digital advertisements

* Flyers

* Posters

* Sales materials

* Service graphics

* Photo composites

* Before-and-after graphics

* Website banners and hero images

* Branded marketing materials

* YouTube thumbnails

* Presentation graphics

* Print-ready marketing materials



The work will vary significantly, so we need someone who can **think creatively rather than simply follow templates.**



## Advanced Photoshop Skills Are Required



Photoshop will be a major part of this position.



You should have advanced experience with:



* Professional photo retouching

* Skin retouching while maintaining natural texture

* Color correction

* Color grading

* Exposure correction

* Object removal

* Background removal

* Background replacement

* Hair masking and detailed selections

* Layer masks

* Adjustment layers

* Smart Objects

* Blend modes

* Advanced selections

* Perspective correction

* Image reconstruction

* Compositing multiple photographs

* Matching lighting between multiple images

* Matching color between multiple photographs

* Creating realistic shadows

* Creating realistic reflections

* Cleaning distracting elements from photographs

* Extending or rebuilding backgrounds

* Product and equipment retouching

* Creating depth and separation within compositions

* Preparing graphics for web and print

* Non-destructive Photoshop workflows



You should be capable of combining **several completely different photographs into one image and making the final composition look intentional and believable.**



## Photo Compositing



A major part of this position involves taking existing photography and turning it into professional marketing imagery.



For example, you may be provided:



* A photograph of a person

* A photograph of an event

* A photograph of equipment

* A venue photograph

* Logos

* Brand assets

* Text

* Multiple reference images



You may then need to combine those elements into **one cohesive advertisement or marketing graphic.**



We need someone who understands:



* Light direction

* Perspective

* Scale

* Depth

* Shadows

* Highlights

* Color temperature

* Image resolution

* Composition



The finished graphic should not look like several photographs pasted together.



It should look like **one professionally created image.**



## Graphic Design Skills



Beyond Photoshop ability, you must have a strong understanding of professional graphic design.



You should understand:



* Visual hierarchy

* Typography

* Font pairing

* Spacing

* Alignment

* Composition

* Negative space

* Contrast

* Balance

* Brand consistency

* Color theory

* Layout

* Advertising design

* Marketing design

* Designing for different aspect ratios

* Designing for mobile versus desktop

* Creating graphics that communicate quickly and clearly



We are looking for someone who understands the difference between something that is simply **technically correct** and something that actually **looks great.**



## Creative Direction



We do not want to provide exact instructions for every design.



Sometimes you may receive a project that simply says:



**"We need a graphic promoting this service. Here are the photos, logo, and information."**



You should be able to determine:



* What photographs should be used

* Which photographs should not be used

* How the composition should be structured

* Where the viewer's eye should go first

* What information should be emphasized

* How much text should appear

* What typography works best

* How the brand should be represented

* Whether the design needs to feel luxury, energetic, corporate, modern, dramatic, clean, etc.



A senior designer should be able to **bring creative ideas to the project rather than waiting for every creative decision to be made for them.**



## Adobe Creative Suite



Advanced Photoshop experience is mandatory.



Experience with the following is also highly preferred:



* Adobe Illustrator

* Adobe InDesign

* Adobe Lightroom

* Adobe Acrobat

* Adobe Bridge



Illustrator experience is particularly valuable for:



* Vector graphics

* Logo manipulation

* Icons

* Typography

* Print graphics

* Scalable design elements



## No AI-Generated Design



**We are specifically looking for traditional professional design and photo-editing skills.**



Generative AI should **not** be used to create finished artwork, photographs, backgrounds, people, equipment, or design elements for our projects unless specifically authorized.



We want someone who understands how to actually use Photoshop.



You should be capable of performing professional:



* Selections

* Masking

* Retouching

* Compositing

* Color correction

* Background replacement

* Image manipulation

* Typography

* Layout



without depending on AI to create the work for you.



Our goal is to maintain control over the quality, accuracy, branding, and authenticity of our imagery.



## Senior-Level Expectations



Because this is a senior position, you should be able to:



* Take ownership of projects.

* Work from limited creative direction.

* Develop multiple strong concepts when needed.

* Explain why you made specific design decisions.

* Recognize when an image or concept isn't working.

* Maintain consistency across an entire brand.

* Work quickly without sacrificing quality.

* Organize Photoshop files professionally.

* Maintain clean layers and editable source files.

* Follow established naming and file-management systems.

* Prepare files correctly for web, social media, and print.

* Review your own work before submitting it.

* Catch spelling, alignment, resolution, and formatting problems.

* Receive creative feedback professionally and make revisions efficiently.



## Required Qualifications



Candidates should have:



* **5+ years of professional graphic design experience preferred.**

* Advanced Adobe Photoshop skills.

* Strong professional portfolio.

* Extensive photo-editing experience.

* Extensive photo-compositing experience.

* Strong typography and layout skills.

* Understanding of professional branding.

* Experience creating marketing and advertising graphics.

* Understanding of print and digital design.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong creative judgment.

* Ability to work independently.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

* Ability to follow established brand standards.



## What We're NOT Looking For



This position is probably not the right fit if your primary experience is:



* Canva templates

* AI image generation

* AI-generated advertisements

* Template-based social media design

* Basic Photoshop editing

* Simple background removal

* Drag-and-drop graphic creation



Those tools have their place, but this position requires someone with **professional-level Photoshop and graphic-design skills.**



We need someone who can actually build, edit, manipulate, and refine the artwork.



## Portfolio Requirements



**A portfolio is required.**



Your portfolio should demonstrate actual professional design work and preferably include:



* Photo composites

* Before-and-after photo editing

* Advertising graphics

* Marketing graphics

* Website graphics

* Social media campaigns

* Event or entertainment graphics

* Professional retouching

* Typography-focused designs

* Photoshop-heavy projects



We are particularly interested in seeing projects where you took **multiple source photographs or assets and created an entirely new finished composition.**



## When Applying



Please provide:



* A link to your portfolio.

* How many years you have worked professionally as a graphic designer.

* Your level of Photoshop experience.

* The Adobe programs you regularly use.

* Examples of your strongest Photoshop compositing work.

* Examples of professional photo retouching.

* Examples of marketing or advertising designs.

* Your normal turnaround time for design projects.

* Whether you work hourly, per project, or on a recurring monthly basis.

* Your availability.



Please also tell us which **three projects in your portfolio best demonstrate your Photoshop ability** and briefly explain what you personally did to create each image.



## Potential Skills Test



Final candidates may be given a **paid design test** using photographs and assets supplied by us.



The purpose of the test is not simply to see whether you can use Photoshop. We want to evaluate your:



* Creativity

* Composition

* Photo-editing ability

* Attention to detail

* Typography

* Ability to follow a brand

* Ability to interpret creative direction

* Layer organization

* Overall professional judgment



We're looking for a designer whose work makes someone stop and say:



**"That looks professionally done."**



If you are a highly experienced designer who genuinely enjoys Photoshop, photo manipulation, compositing, and creating polished visual marketing materials from scratch, we'd like to see your work.

title: Viral Content Creation — AICreator Business
description:
We run multiple AI-generated social media creators on
. Each creator has a unique brand, personality, and niche, monetized through subscription-based platforms. Content ranges from lifestyle to bold and provocative, aimed at mature audiences.



Content production is largely automated through N8N workflows, AI image generation, and AI video generation, producing hundreds of posts per month.



The Role



We need someone who lives and breathes viral content to manage, optimize, and scale this operation. Your understanding of what makes people share content directly determines results.



This is a viral content strategist role with real performance bonuses for every post that goes viral.



What You'll Do



- Produce content manually when workflows need fixes or adjustments

- Manage and troubleshoot complex N8N workflows that power the entire content pipeline

- Optimize AI prompts and wildcards daily to maximize content quality and viral potential

- Analyze content performance and identify what works per creator, then scale those patterns

- Build and maintain a database of proven viral content formats

- Ensure every piece of content stays on-brand for each creator's personality and niche

- Research viral formats and translate them into our automated systems

- Scale what works, which is 90% of output, and test new creative formats, which is 10%



Current state:

We clone proven viral formats from other creators, adapted to our own brands. The process is largely automated but needs daily management and optimization.



Where we're going:

A fully creative pipeline that generates original viral concepts from scratch. You'll steer an AI content engine, not just manage it.



Who You Are



Viral content expert:

You have made content go viral before, multiple times, with proof. You understand hooks, emotional triggers, share psychology, and format structures. You know that viral on
 means shares. You can look at any piece of content and predict whether it will perform, and explain exactly why.



AI prompting specialist:

You work daily with LLMs such as ChatGPT and Claude. You write structured prompts that produce consistent, high-quality output. You understand prompt engineering as a real skill. Experience with AI image and video generation prompting is required.



N8N / automation operator:

You have worked with N8N or similar tools such as Make or Zapier. You can read, debug, and modify complex workflows independently. You are comfortable with JSON, webhooks, and troubleshooting integrations.



Brand builder:

You know how to build and maintain a consistent brand and personality from scratch. Every post must feel like it comes from the same person, even at scale.



Social native:

You understand the social media algorithm, what makes users share, and how Reels distribution works.



Organized and independent:

You track your own work without being managed. You document what you do. You flag issues before they become problems.



You'll Thrive Here If



- You are obsessed with understanding why content goes viral, not just watching it happen

- You love optimizing systems by changing one variable, measuring the result, and improving again

- You are comfortable with bold and provocative content aimed at mature audiences

- You get excited about AI tools and automation, and see them as creative leverage, not just tech

- You want to grow with a business, not just fill a seat

- You think in data and patterns, not feelings and guesses



You'll Struggle Here If



- You have never made content go viral and cannot show proof

- You are uncomfortable working with mature or provocative content

- You need step-by-step instructions for every task

- You see AI as a gimmick rather than a production tool

- You want a predictable 9-to-5 with no ambition beyond the base salary

- You have another job or freelance work alongside this role, because this must be your only commitment

- You avoid troubleshooting technical issues and wait for someone else to fix things



Why Join Us?



Compensation



- Base: $400/month for 40 hours/week, Monday to Friday

- Viral bonuses: paid per post that crosses performance thresholds of 25K, 100K, or 500K likes

- With hundreds of posts going out monthly, strong performers consistently earn $1000+ in monthly bonuses on top of base

- As the operation scales, hours and compensation grow with it



Growth



- You are joining at the ground floor of a scaling AI content operation

- The role evolves from managing cloned content today to steering a fully creative AI content engine

- We need someone who grows into a leadership role as we expand



What You Get to Work With



- Cutting-edge AI tools for image and video generation

- Fully automated N8N content pipelines

- A tested viral format database and content strategy



How to Apply



Generic applications will be ignored. Attach your CV with your previous work experience, and answer all of the following:



1. Viral proof

Share content you personally created or were directly responsible for that got significant reach.



2. Platform experience

List every social media platform you have professional experience with. For each platform, include your role, how long you worked on it, and the best result you achieved, such as followers grown, views on a single post, or engagement rate.

title: AI Video Editor — DTC Creative Ads (Realistic AI Generation)
description:
The Role

We're a DTC brand that lives and dies by creative, and we're looking for an AI video editor who can generate highly realistic, believable AI video — not the uncanny, obviously-synthetic stuff, but footage and avatars that hold up as real ad creative in the feed. You'll turn prompts, product assets, and UGC into scroll-stopping ads for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, using AI generation to produce content that would be slow, expensive, or impossible to shoot.



This is a craft-plus-volume role. The bar is realism: if your AI-generated humans, environments, and product shots pass as authentic and convert like real footage, you'll thrive here.





What You'll Own

Generating photorealistic AI video — lifelike avatars/spokespeople, realistic environments, and product footage that reads as genuine, not synthetic.

Editing direct-response ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube — hooks, UGC-style edits, VSLs, listicles, and demos built to convert.

High-volume variant production — spinning winning concepts into many testable variations (hooks, avatars, scenes, captions, pacing, CTAs, aspect ratios).

Realism QA — catching and fixing the tells that break believability: warped hands, off lip-sync, unnatural motion, lighting mismatches, artifacting.

Format discipline — native 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 cuts optimized per placement.





What You Bring

A portfolio of highly realistic AI-generated video — this is the core requirement. Show us AI footage or avatars that are hard to clock as synthetic.

Deep, hands-on command of AI video generation tools — e.g., Kling, Seedance, Veo, HeyGen/Synthesia (realistic avatars), ElevenLabs (voice/lip-sync) — and the prompting and post skills to push each toward realism.

Strong editing and compositing fundamentals (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut) to grade, retime, clean up, and blend AI output into a seamless finished ad.

A real point of view on DTC / direct-response creative — hooks, retention, sound-off editing, and why the first 3 seconds matter.

Sharp eye for the details that separate believable AI from uncanny, plus speed and consistency at volume.





Nice to Have

Motion graphics/VFX and compositing chops, custom avatar or voice-clone creation, image-to-video and upscaling workflows (e.g., Topaz), familiarity with Meta/TikTok ad and AI-disclosure policies, and a sense for testing angles.





How to Apply

Send your portfolio with: your most realistic AI-generated clip (and how you made it), a DTC ad you edited that performed well, and a rough sense of how many ad variants you can turn around in a week.

title: VIP Client Support Associate
description:
We're building a remote VIP Support team for a Japan-based fintech platform, and we're looking for people we can grow from the ground up — not just workers, but the kind of people who take genuine pride in doing things right. This role blends support with relationship-building: you won't just resolve client concerns, you'll also learn to spot the right moments to introduce clients to more of what we offer.



This is not a call center role. You'll be managing real relationships with high-value clients — providing support, but also recognizing opportunities to grow those relationships — and holding yourself to a high standard on every single interaction. Our clients are VIPs — quality is the only standard. We train every associate to think critically and work out the correct response on their own, using AI as a support tool rather than a substitute for judgment. Once you've proven you can consistently get it right, you'll be trusted to move fast — real speed is earned through skill, not shortcuts.



We're a growing team, and we mean that literally — the processes, tools, and structure you'll work with are still being shaped, and we actively want people who take initiative to help shape them. The culture here is built on mutual trust, shared accountability, and a genuine respect for doing things well. If that resonates with you, keep reading.



Responsibilities:



• Handle inbound client inquiries via messaging platforms with care and thoroughness

• Recognize natural opportunities within conversations to introduce clients to relevant features, promotions, or products that genuinely add value to them

• Use our drafting tool to sharpen your own well-considered responses for supervisor review — the tool supports your judgment; it doesn't replace it

• Keep thorough, accurate track of each client's concerns and history — nothing gets forgotten, nothing falls through the cracks

• Escalate immediately to your Lead when handling an irate or escalating client — do not attempt to resolve it alone

• Maintain detailed and accurate client interaction logs

• Follow team rules, protocols, and procedures diligently — structure exists for a reason and will be respected

• We believe every client interaction is a once-in-a-lifetime encounter that deserves your full presence and care.



What We're Looking For:



• Early career — fresh graduates welcome, but you need real client-facing experience (internship, part-time work, thesis project, VA work, or similar counts)

• High energy and quick on your feet — comfortable with fast, informal communication (voice notes, memes, Slack chaos included) and unfazed by a startup's rough edges

• Confident — you speak up, express yourself clearly, and don't go quiet when things get uncomfortable

• Understands hierarchy — you know when to handle something yourself and when to bring it to your Lead, and you act without being told

• Conscientious — you track every detail, follow through, and take full ownership of every client you handle

• Relationship-minded — you can naturally spot opportunities to add value for a client, not just resolve their immediate issue

• Follows rules diligently — protocols aren't suggestions

• Strong written English — clear, warm, and professional

• Sharp critical thinking — you can reason through a client's situation yourself, not just reword what a tool gives you

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as an aid, not a crutch

• High discretion — you'll be handling sensitive VIP information

• Startup mindset — adaptable, steady, and not easily rattled



Bonus Points (not required, but we will prioritize you):



• Holds a TESDA BPO NC II certification

• HubSpot or Zendesk Customer Service certification

• Google AI Essentials or equivalent AI literacy certificate

• JLPT N2/N1 or business-level fluency — especially valuable if you can review Japanese-language drafts for tone and accuracy

• Familiar with crypto, DeFi, or fintech products

• Experience in sales, account management, upselling, or client retention

• Has handled foreign or executive-level clients before



Reporting to: VIP Support Lead and Growth Operations Lead



Setup:



• 100% WFH from day one

• 8 AM–4 PM Philippine Time (JST business hours) to start, 5 days/week — this window may extend depending on client traffic and business needs, so come in with realistic expectations around hours

• No time tracker

• Overtime available as needed and subject to supervisor approval

• Team communication via Slack

• BYOD — stable fiber internet required

• Confidentiality/NDA agreement required before you handle any client information

• Paid training and evaluation period — Part-Time status, working full 8-hour days, running through the 30th of the month you're hired (this lines up with our salary reporting cycle)

• Promotion to Full-Time is based on your evaluation — if your performance is clearly solid early on, that promotion can happen before the 30th too

• Initiative is welcomed — stepping up when it's needed is part of the culture here

• Internal growth and promotions for top performers



To Apply:



Start your message with the subject line:

[VIP Support] – [Your Name] – [City]



Then answer all three questions below. We read every response personally — take your time with these.



1. You're handling five VIP clients at the same time. One sends you a voice note. One sends a meme with no context. One hasn't replied in 3 days and suddenly needs urgent help. One says "???" and one says "never mind." Walk us through your exact next 10 minutes.

2. If we give you a chance at this role, what is the one thing you can promise us?

3. Think of a time you were part of a startup or company — what's one initiative you personally established that's still in use today (or was used before you left), and became part of how that company actually operates?



A note on AI: using it to help you write is fine — we use it ourselves. But we can tell when an answer wasn't reviewed by the person sending it. Edit before you submit.



Important: Do not use any of the following words anywhere in your application — passionate, dedicated, hardworking, committed, team player, fast learner, or go-getter. Applications containing these words will not be reviewed. We want your real voice, not resume language.



Applications without the correct subject line and all three answers will not be reviewed.

title: AI Creative Strategist & Static Ad Expert for E-Commerce | Full-Time Growth Role
description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce company building and scaling multiple brands through performance marketing.



Our team is made up of ambitious, intelligent and creative people who move quickly, test aggressively and constantly look for ways to improve.



We are now looking for an exceptional **Creative Strategist / AI Static Ad Expert** to join our team long-term.



This is NOT simply a graphic design position.



We are looking for someone who understands **direct-response advertising, creative strategy, AI and consumer psychology** and can take winning ads, understand WHY they are working, and develop new variations and completely new concepts around them.



Our main focus is **static advertising**, although video editing experience is a major advantage.



Job Responsibilities:



* Create high-quality static ad variations based on our existing winning creatives.

* Analyse winning advertisements and identify the hooks, angles, messaging and visual elements responsible for their performance.

* Develop completely new creative concepts rather than simply copying existing advertisements.

* Create new hooks, angles and visual approaches for different stages of customer awareness.

* Develop **Top of Funnel creative concepts**, including native-style ads with longer-form text and copy designed to educate, create curiosity and introduce customers to new problems or solutions.

* Use AI extensively to speed up creative research, ideation, copywriting and production.

* Use **Claude** to help develop creative concepts, angles, hooks, copy and detailed prompts.

* Turn these concepts into strong visual prompts that can be produced using tools such as **Gemini** and other leading AI image-generation platforms.

* Continuously create multiple variations of winning concepts for creative testing.

* Research competitors and advertising trends to identify new creative opportunities.

* Work closely with the rest of our marketing team to develop creatives around products we are currently scaling.

* Understand feedback and rapidly iterate creatives based on performance and direction.

* If experienced with video editing, create video variations and new video concepts alongside static creatives.

* Constantly stay up to date with new AI platforms, models, workflows and creative-generation techniques.



Skills & Capabilities:



* Strong experience creating **direct-response static advertisements**, preferably for e-commerce brands.

* Excellent understanding of creative strategy and what makes someone stop scrolling, read an ad and take action.

* Strong understanding of customer psychology, hooks, angles, awareness levels and advertising concepts.

* Highly experienced with AI and genuinely interested in staying ahead of new AI developments.

* Very familiar with **Claude** for creative ideation, copywriting, concept development and prompt creation.

* Experience using **Gemini** and other AI image-generation tools to turn concepts into finished creatives.

* Familiar with current AI tools for image generation, image editing, copywriting, creative research and content creation.

* Able to look at a winning advertisement and create multiple fresh variations without destroying the elements that made the original successful.

* Able to develop completely new concepts independently rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.

* Strong visual judgement and extremely high attention to detail.

* Experience with Photoshop, Canva or similar creative software is beneficial.

* **Video editing experience is a major bonus**, particularly for creating variations of existing winning video ads.

* Fluent English is REQUIRED. You must be able to communicate ideas, concepts and feedback clearly and professionally.

* Familiar and comfortable working through **Slack**.

* Highly intelligent, proactive and capable of solving problems independently.

* Coachable and able to take feedback without needing constant supervision.

* Comfortable working in a **fast-paced environment** where creatives are constantly being tested and improved.



Who We're Looking For:



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to be given a design and recreates it.



We want someone who can think.



You should be able to look at a product, customer avatar or winning advertisement and start thinking:



* What other angles could we test?

* What new hooks could work?

* Why did this creative perform?

* How could we create 10 genuinely different variations?

* What would work for a customer who has never heard of this problem?

* What visual could stop someone scrolling?

* How can AI help us produce and test these ideas faster?

title: Experienced Funnel Builder | Funnelish, Shopify and Ecommerce
description:
Please read the complete post before applying. We are looking for an experienced Funnel Builder, not an entry-level page designer.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Capital Heaven is looking for an experienced Funnel Builder to create, localize, connect, test and deliver ecommerce funnels for our health, beauty, wellness and personal-care brands.



You must be able to take a written task, understand the required product and market, duplicate an approved source funnel, complete the technical setup and test the entire customer journey without constant supervision.



This position is for a Funnel Builder. A candidate with extensive experience who later demonstrates strong technical ability, ownership, quality control and leadership may be considered for training toward a Funnel Manager position.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Review each ClickUp task and Slack handoff before starting.

- Confirm the correct product name and code, approved source funnel, store, country, language, currency, offer, deadline and required pages.

- Duplicate the approved source funnel before making changes. Never edit a live winning funnel directly.

- Build and localize advertorials, sales pages, checkout paths and other required funnel pages in Funnelish.

- Preserve the approved page structure, primary angle, offer and customer journey unless different written instructions are provided.

- Update market-specific language, spelling, currency, units, names, locations, images, buttons, disclaimers and footer information.

- Create and configure Shopify products, variants, quantities, prices, compare-at prices, images, SKUs, URL paths and other required product details.

- Connect every funnel button and bundle option to the correct Shopify product and variant.

- Configure funnel automations, domains, redirects, tracking, pixels and required events according to the approved SOP.

- Work with WeTracked or similar tracking tools when required.

- Test the complete live journey on desktop and mobile, including page flow, buttons, bundles, pricing, shipping, checkout, payment options and tracking.

- Fix failed checks and repeat the affected customer journey before submitting the funnel.

- Update the required research sheet, ClickUp task and Slack thread with the live funnel URL, market information, test results, screenshots and blockers.

- Coordinate with product research, creative, media buying and Meta asset teams during handoffs.

- Escalate missing information, conflicting instructions, technical issues and compliance risks before they affect a live launch.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven professional experience building ecommerce or dropshipping funnels.

- Strong hands-on experience with Funnelish.

- Practical experience with Shopify product setup, variants, pricing, SKUs, checkout links and order paths.

- Experience replicating or adapting proven funnels while maintaining accurate structure and functionality.

- Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile optimization.

- Ability to troubleshoot broken buttons, incorrect variants, checkout errors, domain issues, redirects and tracking problems.

- Experience with pixels, events and ecommerce tracking tools.

- Strong attention to product codes, markets, prices, offers, currencies and technical details.

- Ability to follow SOPs and written instructions without skipping required checks.

- Clear written English and reliable communication in Slack and ClickUp.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines without sacrificing quality.

- Full-time and long-term availability.



NICE TO HAVE



- Previous experience leading, training or reviewing the work of other funnel builders.

- Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplements or personal-care products.

- Experience with WeTracked, Meta Pixel, Google Sheets, Google Drive and ecommerce reporting tools.

- Familiarity with direct-response copy, advertorials, upsells, bundles and conversion-rate optimization.

- Experience building funnels for multiple countries, languages, currencies and stores.



QUALITY AND COMPLIANCE EXPECTATIONS



Accuracy is more important than rushing a funnel live. You must stop and request clarification when the product, source funnel, store, market, language, currency, offer, deadline, shipping, checkout, tracking or approval is missing or conflicting.



You must flag unsupported medical or authority claims, guaranteed results, misleading before-and-after content, incorrect testimonials, wrong-market assets, excessive discounts, and incorrect products, variants, prices, currencies, domains, pixels or checkout links.



Do not place a real order or make an unapproved change to a live winning funnel.



WHAT WE OFFER



- A long-term, full-time remote opportunity.

- Clear SOPs, checklists and task-based workflows.

- The opportunity to work across multiple ecommerce brands and markets.

- A possible future path toward Funnel Manager training for a highly experienced Funnel Builder who proves strong technical ability, ownership and leadership.

- Compensation based on demonstrated experience and skill level.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word FUNNEL so we know you read the complete post.



Answer all questions below. Use specific examples and numbers whenever possible.



1. How many years of professional funnel-building experience do you have, and how much of it was for ecommerce or dropshipping brands?

2. Describe your hands-on experience with Funnelish. Which page types and technical setups have you completed yourself?

3. Describe your Shopify experience, including products, variants, quantities, SKUs, prices, checkout links and bundle connections.

4. Share two or three live or recorded examples of funnels you personally built. Explain exactly which parts you completed. Remove or hide confidential client information.

5. Walk us through your process for duplicating, localizing, connecting and testing a proven funnel for a new country or market.

6. How do you verify that every button, bundle, Shopify variant, price, currency, shipping option and checkout path is correct?

7. Describe a difficult funnel, checkout, domain, automation or tracking issue you diagnosed and fixed.

8. What experience do you have with WeTracked, Meta Pixel, events, domains, redirects or other ecommerce tracking systems?

9. How many complete funnels can you normally deliver per week while maintaining strong desktop and mobile QA?

10. Have you trained or reviewed other funnel builders? If yes, briefly explain your experience.

11. Are you available full-time and long-term? State your earliest possible start date and any recurring schedule limitations.

12. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?



Applications without relevant Funnelish experience, Shopify knowledge and funnel examples will not be prioritized.



Qualified candidates will receive a message through OnlineJobs with an invitation for an initial interview.

title: Content Writer and Fact-Checker (long-term, Australian company)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a small Australian company. We build websites and get them found in search, including inside AI answers. Our clients are in a range of industries. We all work remotely.





ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a writer with a keen eye for fact-checking.



Every article starts as an AI draft, for our clients and for our own website. Your work is to turn that draft into something worth publishing.



Some need checking and a light edit. Others you would rewrite most of yourself.





WHAT YOU WOULD DO



- Fact-check our drafts. Open every link and confirm the source says what the article claims.

- Rewrite the parts that come back weak, which is sometimes most of the article.

- Edit each article into the client's style, which we will give you.

- Tell us when something is wrong, including when it is our mistake.





WHAT YOU GET FROM US



The topic, the client's brand notes, and a tool that flags claims worth a second look. The tool is a starting point rather than an answer, so the final call is yours.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent written English.

- The ability to cut. Four paragraphs that say one thing become one paragraph.

- Comfort telling us we are wrong. We will be glad you did.



Experience checking facts is a bonus, whether that came from journalism, sub-editing, publishing or academic editing. SEO experience is a bonus too. Neither is required.





HOURS



We work Melbourne time, so your day overlaps with most of ours. No night shifts.





HOW WE HIRE



Two short paid tests, $25 and $15, then a paid trial article. We pay for all of it either way, and we will tell you how you did.



Your first month is a trial for both of us.





HOW TO APPLY



Please start your message with the word "offset", so we know you have read this.



Then answer two questions:



1. What writing or editing work have you done?

2. Have you ever caught a mistake in something before it went out? What happened?



Keep it short. Two good answers tell us more than a long application.

title: Automotive Parts Research Specialist – VIN / TecDoc / OEM Cross Reference
description:
## Automotive Parts Research Specialist – VIN / TecDoc / OEM Cross Reference



We are an automotive parts company looking for a reliable full-time remote team member to help our sales team identify the correct automotive parts quickly and accurately.



### Main Responsibilities



* Search automotive parts by VIN, vehicle details, engine code, and model

* Identify correct OEM / OE part numbers

* Find aftermarket alternatives and cross-reference part numbers

* Work with TecDoc and other automotive parts catalogs

* Compare part numbers between different suppliers and manufacturers

* Update product and supplier mappings in our ERP system

* Prepare information for our sales team so they can quote customers quickly

* Check unclear or difficult vehicle/part matches

* Keep records organized and accurate

* Report when there are multiple possible parts or when you are not 100% sure



### Very Important



Accuracy is more important than speed.



We do not want someone who guesses.



If there are two possible parts for a vehicle, you must clearly report that further verification is required.



### Experience We Prefer



Experience with any of the following is a big advantage:



* TecDoc

* OEM / OE automotive part numbers

* VIN lookup

* EPC systems

* Parts catalogues

* Bosch

* MANN

* MAHLE

* Denso

* Valeo

* VAG / ETKA

* BMW ETK

* Mercedes EPC

* Toyota / Hyundai / Kia / Japanese or European vehicle catalogues

* Automotive spare parts e-commerce or wholesale companies



### Work Style



This is not a customer service role.



You will mainly work as a back-office automotive parts research specialist supporting our sales team.



You must be:



* Very detail-oriented

* Reliable

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at researching difficult cases

* Able to follow procedures

* Comfortable using Excel / Google Sheets / ERP systems

* Honest when you are unsure about a part match



### Working Hours



Full-time preferred.



Working hours should overlap with Israel business hours for at least part of the day.



Israel time is UTC+2 / UTC+3 depending on daylight saving time.



### Salary



Starting salary: **USD $650–$800 per month**, depending on automotive parts experience and skill level.



Salary can increase after the probation period based on accuracy, productivity, reliability, and ability to work independently.



### Application Test



Please do not send a generic application.



In your application, answer these questions:



1. Have you worked with automotive spare parts before? Please explain.

2. Have you used TecDoc? For how long?

3. Which EPC or automotive catalog systems have you used?

4. Are you comfortable finding OE/OEM numbers using a VIN?

5. Which vehicle brands do you know best?

6. Give one example of how you would verify that a part definitely fits a specific vehicle.

7. What is your expected monthly salary?

8. Can you work full-time?

9. What hours can you work in Philippine time?



Please start your application with the words:



**PARTS RESEARCH**



Applications without these words may not be reviewed.



### Paid Trial



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid practical test involving real vehicle and part lookup cases.



We will measure:



* Accuracy

* Speed

* Ability to cross-reference parts

* Ability to identify uncertainty

* Quality of documentation



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our team.

description:
About the work



We run a YouTube documentary channel covering the darker side of what's happening in the world — scandals, corruption, fraud, the stories behind how things really work. Our style references are James Jani and Magnates Media. Watch several videos from both before applying. If that kind of storytelling doesn't excite you, this isn't the right job.



James Jani: 

Another New Documentary Channel Example: 



We only do documentaries. Nothing else.



What you'll do:



Write fully researched, deeply engaging documentary scripts. 



That means:



Real research. Primary sources where possible. Every claim has to hold up, because getting a fact wrong on this kind of channel costs us the audience's trust permanently.

Structure that holds attention for the full runtime — an opening that earns the next ten minutes, and tension carried all the way to the end.

Writing for narration. It has to sound right read aloud, not just look right on the page.

Advising us. If you know this format better than we do, say so. We want a collaborator, not a typist.



AI: strongly discouraged. We're hiring a writer, not an operator. If you use AI at all, it should be minimal and for support — organizing research (very minimal, you need to prove the facts), not generating prose. 

We read closely and we will ask you about your process. Be upfront about it.



Requirements:



- Proven experience writing documentary or long-form YouTube scripts

- Strong understanding of YouTube — retention, hooks, why people click and why they leave

title: Supply Chain & Inventory Planning Manager
description:
We are a fast-growing consumer brand operating across DTC, retail, and wholesale channels. As the business continues to scale, we're looking for a seasoned Supply Chain & Inventory Planning Manager to take strategic ownership of our supply chain, inventory planning, and procurement function.



This is not a PO-processing or inventory tracking role. We're looking for a senior operator who can lead with a critical, commercial mindset — someone who has done this before in a CPG or food & beverage environment, knows what good looks like, and doesn't need to be told what to look for. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, exceptional in Excel, and ready to take full ownership of the supply chain function with the ability to grow into a broader operations leadership role over time.



Work Structure & Requirements

Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time initially, with opportunity to grow into full-time

Time Zone: Pacific Time Zone

Compensation: $10 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities

1. Inventory Planning & S&OP Leadership



Own key components of the S&OP process end to end — connecting demand forecasts, inventory requirements, production schedules, and purchasing decisions

Partner closely with the Growth team to understand demand forecasts and translate these into actionable inventory and raw material requirements

Build, maintain, and continuously improve detailed Excel-based inventory planning and forecasting models

Monitor inventory levels, lead times, safety stock, and expected demand to proactively identify potential shortages, excess inventory, or production constraints

Apply senior-level critical thinking to forecasts and assumptions — proactively challenge numbers where they don't make operational sense

Develop a clear view of upcoming production requirements and confidently communicate assumptions, risks, and recommendations to leadership



2. Procurement & Vendor Management



Translate production and inventory plans into raw material and ingredient purchase schedules

Source and order ingredients, packaging, and other required raw materials

Prepare, issue, and manage purchase orders through to delivery

Build and maintain strong, professional relationships with suppliers including farms and ingredient producers

Lead negotiations on pricing, minimum order quantities, payment/net terms, lead times, and other commercial terms

Track inbound materials and shipments, following up proactively to ensure production timelines remain on schedule



3. Financial & Cross-Functional Planning



Partner with the Finance team to translate upcoming purchasing requirements into a forecast of expected cash outlays

Maintain clear visibility into when cash will be required for ingredients, production, and other inventory-related commitments

Work cross-functionally with Growth, Finance, and Operations to ensure demand, purchasing, and financial planning remain tightly aligned

Serve as the go-to voice for supply chain decisions — clearly communicating inventory recommendations, assumptions, risks, and upcoming requirements to stakeholders



4. Systems & Operational Leadership



Work confidently across Excel and our broader supply chain technology stack, including ERP, 3PL, Shopify, and other operational platforms

Lead the effective use and ongoing development of our ERP environment — NetSuite or comparable ERP experience is highly valuable

Maintain accurate inventory, purchasing, and supplier records across all relevant systems

As the role develops, take broader ownership of omnichannel operations across DTC, retail, wholesale, and distribution



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in supply chain, inventory planning, procurement, and S&OP — ideally within food & beverage or CPG; prior experience in a senior associate, manager, or director-level role is strongly preferred

Excel & Modelling: Exceptional Excel and financial/operational modelling skills — this is critical to the role

Supply Chain: Deep understanding of the end-to-end CPG supply chain, from raw materials and manufacturing through 3PL/distribution and ultimately DTC and retail channels

Analytical: Strong analytical ability with the confidence to interrogate data, challenge assumptions, and make independent recommendations — not just process information

ERP: Experience with NetSuite or another leading ERP platform

Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable presenting recommendations and assumptions clearly to leadership

Profile: Senior operator with strong commercial judgment, comfortable owning decisions in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment, and able to manage multiple moving pieces across vendors, inventory, production, and logistics independently



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume and introduction video
