title: VIDEO EDITOR & SEO CONTENT SPECIALIST
description:
VIDEO EDITOR & SEO CONTENT SPECIALIST



**Work Arrangement:** Remote

**Position Type:** Full
-Time

**Reports To:** Marketing / Executive Leadership



 POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a creative, technically skilled, and results-oriented **Video Editor & SEO Content Specialist** to help grow our company's digital presence through professional video content, YouTube optimization, search engine optimization, and content distribution.



This position goes beyond simply editing videos.



The successful candidate will be responsible for helping transform raw footage, interviews, podcasts, educational content, customer stories, and promotional videos into professional content that is designed to **attract attention, rank in search, increase engagement, generate leads, and strengthen our brand.**



The ideal candidate understands both:



**VIDEO PRODUCTION + CONTENT DISCOVERY**



We want someone who understands that producing a great video is only part of the job. The content must also be properly packaged, optimized, published, and analyzed so the right audience can find it.



---



# PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



## 1. VIDEO EDITING & PRODUCTION



Edit professional video content for platforms including:



* YouTube

*

* Instagram

* TikTok

* LinkedIn

* Company websites

* Podcasts

* Training platforms

*
 and marketing campaigns



Responsibilities include:



* Edit raw video footage into polished finished content.

* Remove unnecessary footage, pauses, mistakes, and distractions.

* Improve pacing and storytelling.

* Add professional transitions when appropriate.

* Add titles and lower thirds.

* Add captions and subtitles.

* Add logos and brand elements.

* Incorporate B-roll.

* Add graphics and motion graphics.

* Perform basic audio cleanup and enhancement.

* Perform basic color correction.

* Select appropriate music and sound effects.

* Create professional intros and outros when needed.

* Export content in the correct formats and resolutions for each platform.



The goal is not simply to make videos look good.



The goal is to make people **want to continue watching them.**



---



# 2. YOUTUBE CHANNEL MANAGEMENT



Help develop and grow the company's YouTube presence.



Responsibilities include:



* Upload and publish videos.

* Optimize video titles.

* Write SEO-focused descriptions.

* Conduct keyword research.

* Add appropriate tags and metadata.

* Create and manage playlists.

* Add chapters/timestamps.

* Add cards and end screens where appropriate.

* Optimize thumbnails.

* Maintain consistent channel branding.

* Organize existing video content.

* Update older videos when optimization opportunities exist.

* Monitor comments and engagement as assigned.

* Help develop the publishing calendar.



The Video Editor & SEO Content Specialist should understand the relationship between:



**TITLE → THUMBNAIL → CLICK → WATCH TIME → ENGAGEMENT → CONVERSION**



---



# 3. VIDEO SEO



SEO knowledge is a major requirement of this position.



The candidate should understand how people search for information and how content can be structured to increase its chances of being discovered.



Responsibilities include:



* Perform keyword research before content is published.

* Identify relevant search topics.

* Research search intent.

* Recommend SEO-friendly video topics.

* Optimize video titles.

* Optimize descriptions.

* Create keyword-focused chapters.

* Recommend supporting website content when appropriate.

* Identify long-tail search opportunities.

* Analyze competitor content.

* Monitor video search performance.

* Recommend improvements based on performance data.



The candidate should understand that we do not want to create content simply because **we want to talk about something.**



We want to understand:



**What is our target customer searching for?**



Then create valuable content around those searches.



---



# 4. WEBSITE & CONTENT SEO SUPPORT



The ideal candidate should also understand fundamental website SEO.



Responsibilities may include:



* Keyword research.

* On-page SEO recommendations.

* Page titles and meta descriptions.

* Heading structure.

* Internal linking recommendations.

* Image/video optimization.

* Video embedding strategies.

* Content optimization.

* Local SEO content opportunities.

* Google search performance analysis.

* Identifying topics for future articles, landing pages, and videos.



Advanced technical SEO knowledge is helpful but is not required to the same degree as video and content SEO.



---



# 5. LONG-FORM TO SHORT-FORM CONTENT



One major responsibility will be maximizing the value of every piece of content we produce.



For example:



**1 Podcast**



could become:



**1 Full YouTube Episode**



→ 5–10 YouTube Shorts



→ 5–10 Instagram/Facebook Reels



→ TikTok clips



→ LinkedIn clips



→ Quote graphics



→ Website content



→
 content



→ Future promotional material



The candidate should actively identify opportunities to **repurpose content instead of allowing valuable footage to be used only once.**



---



# 6. PODCAST & INTERVIEW EDITING



The candidate may be responsible for editing company podcasts and interview-style content.



Responsibilities may include:



* Multi-camera editing.

* Audio synchronization.

* Removing unnecessary pauses and mistakes.

* Improving conversational pacing.

* Adding speaker identification.

* Creating intros and outros.

* Adding graphics and supporting visuals.

* Creating promotional clips.

* Creating Shorts/Reels from long-form episodes.

* Optimizing podcast/video titles and descriptions for discovery.



---



# 7. THUMBNAILS & VISUAL PACKAGING



The candidate should understand the importance of thumbnails and visual presentation.



Responsibilities include:



* Create compelling YouTube thumbnails.

* Maintain brand consistency.

* Test different thumbnail concepts.

* Use readable typography.

* Select compelling video frames.

* Create curiosity without misleading viewers.

* Monitor click-through rates.

* Recommend thumbnail changes when performance is weak.



Graphic design experience is highly desirable.



---



# 8. CONTENT STRATEGY



We want this person to contribute ideas—not simply wait for footage.



The candidate should help answer:



* What should we create?

* Who is the target audience?

* What are they searching for?

* What problems can we help them solve?

* Which videos are performing best?

* What topics should we create next?

* What content can be repurposed?

* Which content is generating leads?

* What should we stop doing?



This position should help turn video production into a **repeatable content engine.**



---



# 9. ANALYTICS & PERFORMANCE REPORTING



The candidate should use data to improve future content.



Monitor metrics such as:



* Views

* Impressions

* Click-through rate

* Watch time

* Average view duration

* Audience retention

* Subscriber growth

* Search traffic

* Engagement

* Website traffic from video

* Leads generated

* Conversion opportunities



Prepare regular reports explaining:



**What worked?**



**What didn't?**



**Why?**



**What should we do next?**



---



# 10. AI-ASSISTED CONTENT PRODUCTION



The candidate should be comfortable using modern AI tools responsibly to improve productivity.



AI may be used to assist with:



* Transcription

* Captioning

* Content research

* Keyword research

* Video summaries

* Title concepts

* Description drafts

* Short-form content identification

* Content repurposing

* Script development

* Thumbnail concepts

* Content calendars



AI should improve productivity—not replace judgment, creativity, or quality control.



---



# REQUIRED SKILLS



Candidates should have strong experience in:



* Professional video editing

* YouTube content production

* Video SEO

* Keyword research

* YouTube optimization

* Short-form video editing

* Long-form video editing

* Audio editing

* Captioning/subtitles

* Content repurposing

* Thumbnail development

* Content analytics



Candidates should also have strong written English and the ability to create compelling titles, descriptions, and supporting copy.



---



# PREFERRED SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE



Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Adobe After Effects

* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe Audition

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut

* Canva



SEO/analytics experience may include tools such as:



* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics

* Google Trends

* YouTube Analytics

* YouTube Studio

* TubeBuddy

* vidIQ

* SEMrush

* Ahrefs

* Similar keyword and SEO research platforms



---



# IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who thinks:



**"How do we make this video better?"**



but also:



**"How will people find this video?"**



**"Why would they click it?"**



**"Why would they continue watching?"**



**"What should they do after watching?"**



**"How can we turn this one video into ten pieces of content?"**



**"How do we know whether this content actually helped grow the business?"**



We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of a:



**Video Editor + SEO Specialist + Content Marketer**



---



# KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS



Performance may be evaluated using:



* Videos completed on schedule

* Editing turnaround time

* Content published per week/month

* Long-form videos produced

* Short-form clips produced

* YouTube impressions

* YouTube click-through rate

* Watch time

* Average audience retention

* Subscriber growth

* Organic search traffic

* Keyword rankings

* Engagement

* Website traffic generated

* Leads attributed to content

* Content repurposing rate



We care about **quality and business results**, not simply the number of videos produced.



---



# WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After becoming established in this position, the company should have a consistent content-production system:



**RESEARCH → PLAN → RECORD → EDIT → OPTIMIZE → PUBLISH → DISTRIBUTE → REPURPOSE → MEASURE → IMPROVE**



Raw footage should not sit unused.



Videos should not be uploaded without optimization.



Long-form content should create additional short-form content.



Performance data should influence future content decisions.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I'm a writer and speaker on AI in innovation and higher education. You'll run my marketing — website, social, content, newsletter, outreach, campaigns, and the numbers behind them.



This job is lead generation. I want to be visible, and I want to be visibly different from everyone else saying the same things about AI. That's what the work is for.



The work is Claude-first: most of it starts as an AI draft that you direct, edit, and publish.



Higher education experience is a plus, not a requirement. I'll bring the subject matter.



HOW THE WORK ACTUALLY GETS DONE



Your job is to edit and post AI content.



Nearly everything — posts, newsletter copy, research,
s, campaign plans — starts as a Claude output. You direct the prompt, edit what comes back, fact-check it, make it sound like me, and publish it. Then you do it again tomorrow.



That's the job. If you're looking for work where you write everything from scratch, this isn't it. If you're already working this way and want more of it, keep reading.



I use Claude myself, daily. I'm not asking you to learn a tool I don't understand — I'll know the difference between a good prompt and a lazy one.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT



Not a virtual assistant role. No calendar management, no inbox triage, no data entry.

Not B2C. All of your experience must be B2B. If your background is ecommerce, dropshipping, or consumer social, this won't translate.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Website and social



Maintain and update the website — pages, posts, speaking and media sections

Run the social channels day to day, LinkedIn first

Create simple graphics (Canva-level)



Content



Edit and publish AI-drafted content across LinkedIn, the website, and social

Launch and run a weekly newsletter — from setup through send



Outreach



 outreach and nurture sequences

Pitch and follow up with podcasts, publications, conferences, and event organizers

Build and maintain the contact lists behind all of it



Campaigns



Plan and run campaigns end to end — book and report launches, events, speaking announcements

Coordinate timing across channels so a launch lands as one thing, not five



Research and engagement



Research topics, sources, and stories to feed the content pipeline

Monitor and respond to comments in real time

Track what's being said in the AI, innovation, and higher-ed conversation and flag what I should weigh in on



Measurement



Track open rates, click rates, traffic, engagement, follower growth, and inbound inquiries

Report weekly: what moved, what didn't, what you're changing next week

I don't want a dashboard. I want to know what to do differently.



Project management



Keep projects moving without me chasing you

Track your own work, own your own deadlines, flag blockers early



REQUIREMENTS



Daily Claude use. Not "I've tried ChatGPT." Actual daily use, and you can show me how you work.

Exceptional organizational skills. You track your own work and I don't have to follow up.

Exceptional speed. Turnaround in hours, not days.

Solid B2B marketing knowledge — integrated marketing, communications, content development, campaign management.

Comfortable with numbers. You read metrics and act on them.

Comfortable with technology. You figure new tools out yourself.

Strong written English. You'll be editing AI output until it stops sounding like AI. That's a real skill and it's most of the job.

Light graphic design. Canva-level is fine.

Overlap with US Pacific business hours — at least four hours a day.



Nice to have: higher education or edtech experience; thought leadership, PR, or editorial background; newsletter operations.



HOURS AND TERMS



Part-time or full-time depending on your skills. Tell me which you want and what you can do.



Paid trial task before anything ongoing.

description:
**Remote / Zoom | Part-Time / Sessions | Integrative & Experiential Approaches**



I am looking for an **experienced holistic wellness, mind-body, or therapeutic practitioner** who has broad knowledge of different approaches to emotional well-being, personal transformation, mind-body work, and deeper patterns of the mind.



I am specifically **NOT looking only for traditional talk therapy or CBT**.



I am interested in working with someone who understands approaches that go beyond simply discussing thoughts and can work with **emotions, the body, nervous system, subconscious patterns, internal parts, beliefs, and deeper experiential processes**.



## MODALITIES I AM INTERESTED IN



You do NOT need to practice every modality below. However, I am particularly interested in applicants with professional training or substantial experience in several of these areas:



* **Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work**

* **Somatic approaches / body-based work**

* **Mind-body approaches**

* **Inner-child work**

* Emotional processing

* Nervous-system regulation

* Breathwork

* Meditation and mindfulness

* Guided visualization

* Subconscious beliefs and patterns

* Trauma-informed approaches

* Attachment-oriented approaches

* Emotional-release techniques

* Integrative or holistic psychology

* Hypnotherapy, where appropriately trained

* Yoga / yoga-based therapeutic practices

* Acupuncture / Traditional Chinese Medicine knowledge

* Energy-oriented practices or energy healing

* Other legitimate holistic or complementary wellness modalities



I am also interested in practitioners familiar with ideas surrounding **meditation, consciousness, the mind-body connection, visualization, emotional states, and personal transformation**, including some of the themes discussed in the work of **Dr. Joe Dispenza and other mind-body/consciousness teachers**.



However, I am **not looking for someone who simply follows one teacher or repeats spiritual ideas**. I want someone with real training, experience, critical thinking, and a broad understanding of different modalities.



## WHAT I WANT TO LEARN AND EXPERIENCE



Part of my goal is educational.



I want someone who can help me understand:



**What different modalities exist? How do they work? What is each one designed to address? What happens during a session? How are they different from conventional talk therapy?**



Where appropriate to your qualifications and scope of practice, I would also like to **experience and practice different techniques through Zoom sessions**, rather than only hearing about them theoretically.



I am interested in discovering approaches that work with the person on multiple levels — **mind, emotions, body, internal patterns, habits, beliefs, awareness, and overall well-being.**



## WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal person might be a:



* Holistic wellness practitioner

* Mind-body practitioner

* Integrative therapist or counselor

* IFS-informed/trained practitioner

* Somatic practitioner

* Trauma-informed practitioner

* Breathwork practitioner

* Meditation/mindfulness teacher

* Hypnotherapist

* Holistic coach with substantial professional training

* Acupuncture/TCM professional with mind-body knowledge

* Integrative wellness practitioner

* Or someone professionally trained across several related modalities



You should be able to clearly distinguish **which modalities you are formally trained/certified/licensed in, which you have practical experience with, and which you are simply knowledgeable about.**



## IMPORTANT



I value open-mindedness, but I also value **professionalism and honesty**.



Please do not claim that a particular technique can cure a medical or psychological condition unless that claim is within your professional scope and supported appropriately.



If you are not a licensed therapist, psychologist, physician, acupuncturist, or other licensed healthcare professional, that is okay — just clearly state your actual qualifications and professional scope.



I am looking for someone who knows **what they know and what they do not know**.



## ZOOM SESSIONS



Sessions will primarily take place remotely through **Zoom**.



You should be comfortable:



* Teaching and explaining different modalities

* Guiding appropriate exercises remotely

* Giving personalized practices between sessions

* Discussing what we observed during an exercise

* Recommending which approaches may be worth exploring further

* Explaining when something should instead be handled by an appropriately licensed or in-person professional



If a modality genuinely requires in-person treatment — for example, acupuncture — I can work with an appropriate local professional. You can still help educate me about the modality and how it fits into the larger mind-body picture.



## APPLICATION



Please answer the following: 



1. **What is your professional background, education, training, licenses, and certifications?**



2. **Which holistic, therapeutic, somatic, mind-body, or complementary modalities are you professionally trained in?**



3. **Do you have experience with IFS/parts work, somatic work, inner-child work, nervous-system regulation, breathwork, meditation, or subconscious-pattern work? Please explain.**

6. **Are you familiar with Dr. Joe Dispenza or similar mind-body/consciousness approaches? If yes, please explain your perspective and experience.**

### YOUR RATE MUST BE INCLUDED.
